jobs.title: Polymechaniker/in 80 - 100% (w/m/d)
jobs.description: Über die Position Der Bereich High Voltage Products der Hitachi Energy ist weltweit anerkannt als Spezialist für Anlagen der Stromübertragung und -verteilung. Innerhalb des Bereichs High Voltage Products ist der Bereich Hochstromsysteme verantwortlich für Entwicklung, Verkauf, Produktion und den Service von Generatorleistungsschaltern. Das kannst du bewirken Durchführung der Montage von PGHV-Produkten gemäss den Vorgaben und Zielsetzungen aus den Qualitätssicherungsverfahren und Arbeitsanweisungen Arbeiten nach Arbeitspapieren wie Kundenaufträgen, technischen Unterlagen, Schemata, Checklisten und Arbeitsplänen Termingerechte und wirtschaftliche Montage der Baugruppen und Schaltersysteme Einhaltung der festgelegten QS-Richtlinien Schwachstellenerkennung und -behebung sowie Meldung an den Vorgesetzten Einhaltung des festgelegten Ablaufs zur Fehlerbehebung Das bringst du mit Abgeschlossene Berufslehre als Polymechaniker\/in Praktische und theoretische Erfahrung in der Maschinenmontage Gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift Gute Kenntnisse im Lesen von Zeichnungsunterlagen und Arbeitspapieren Selbständige, zuverlässige und saubere Arbeitsweise Verantwortungs- und qualitätsbewusste Persönlichkeit Flexibilität, Ausdauer sowie Zielstrebigkeit runden dein Profil ab Mehr über uns    Hitachi Energy steht für innovative Technologien und nachhaltige Energielösungen weltweit. Bei uns erwartet dich ein sicherer Arbeitsplatz in einem zukunftsorientierten Unternehmen, spannende Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten, ein kollegiales und wertschätzendes Arbeitsumfeld sowie attraktive Sozialleistungen.

descriptionByLocale.it: Informazioni sulla posizione La divisione Prodotti ad alta tensione di Hitachi Energy è riconosciuta a livello mondiale come specialista nei sistemi di trasmissione e distribuzione di energia. All'interno della divisione Prodotti ad alta tensione, la divisione Sistemi ad alta corrente è responsabile dello sviluppo, della vendita, della produzione e dell'assistenza degli interruttori automatici per generatori. Questo è quello che puoi fare Eseguire il montaggio dei prodotti PGHV in conformità con le specifiche e gli obiettivi delle procedure di garanzia della qualità e delle istruzioni di lavoro Lavorare secondo documenti di lavoro come ordini del cliente, documenti tecnici, diagrammi, liste di controllo e piani di lavoro Montaggio tempestivo ed economico dei gruppi e dei sistemi di commutazione Rispetto delle linee guida QS stabilite Individuazione ed eliminazione dei punti deboli e segnalazione al supervisore Rispetto della procedura stabilita per la risoluzione dei problemi Cosa portare con sé Formazione professionale completata come polimeccanico Pratica e teorica Esperienza nell'assemblaggio di macchine Buona conoscenza della lingua tedesca parlata e scritta Buona conoscenza della lettura di documenti di disegno e carte di lavoro Modo di lavorare indipendente, affidabile e pulito Personalità responsabile e attenta alla qualità Flessibilità, resistenza e determinazione completano il tuo profilo Maggiori informazioni su di noi Hitachi Energy è sinonimo di tecnologie innovative e soluzioni energetiche sostenibili in tutto il mondo. Con noi puoi aspettarti un lavoro sicuro in un'azienda orientata al futuro, interessanti opportunità di sviluppo, un ambiente di lavoro collegiale e riconoscente nonché interessanti vantaggi sociali.
descriptionByLocale.en:
About the position Hitachi Energy's High Voltage Products division is recognized worldwide as a specialist in power transmission and distribution systems. Within the High Voltage Products division, the High Current Systems division is responsible for the development, sales, production and service of generator circuit breakers. This is what you can do Carrying out the assembly of PGHV products in accordance with the specifications and objectives from the quality assurance procedures and work instructions Working according to working papers such as customer orders, technical documents, diagrams, checklists and work plans Timely and economical assembly of the assemblies and switch systems Compliance with the established QS guidelines Identification and elimination of weak points as well as reporting to the supervisor Compliance with the established procedure for troubleshooting 
• What you bring with you Completed vocational training as a polymechanic Practical and theoretical Experience in machine assembly Good knowledge of spoken and written German Good knowledge of reading drawing documents and working papers Independent, reliable and clean way of working Responsible and quality-conscious personality Flexibility, endurance and determination round off your profile More about us Hitachi Energy stands for innovative technologies and sustainable energy solutions worldwide. With us you can expect a secure job in a future-oriented company, exciting development opportunities, a collegial and appreciative working environment as well as attractive social benefits.

jobs.title: Internship / Working Student in Business Project Management 40 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity Hitachi Energy, High Voltage Products, is a global leader in power transmission and distribution. The Service Business Unit ensures worldwide after-sales support for GCB and GIS systems. You will join a collaborative team driving growth and operational excellence. You support a Business Project Manager across impactful internal initiatives. As an intern or a working student you gain insights across the full service value chain and take ownership of selected projects under guidance. The duration is 6 - 12 months. How you'll make an impact Support execution of internal projects across the service value chain Collaborate with stakeholders from different functions and regions Contribute to initiatives improving efficiency and collaboration Prepare and structure project documentation and presentations Track progress and ensure transparent communication across teams Identify improvement opportunities and support implementation Take ownership of smaller projects under supervision Support coordination and alignment within the project environment Your background E nrolled Student (Bachelor or Master) or Graduate in Industrial Engineering, Mechanical \/ Electrical Engineer, Business Management, or related field Strong interest in project management and collaboration Basic technical or IT understanding Analytical mindset and structured way of working Proactive communication style and problem solving attitude Strong MS Office skills and fluency in English and German More about us We are a technology-driven company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing. 
• We offer flexible working conditions, dedicated mentorship, and a supportive, inclusive environment where you can grow personally and professionally – empowering you to thrive while balancing life and work. We look forward to receiving your application, including a brief cover letter and a transcript of records, along with your CV. Non-EU\/EFTA citizens, please note that an official university certificate showing that an internship is a mandatory part of your studies is required.

jobs.title: Production Engineer 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity  Our local Insulation & Components product group is the technical market leader in the development and manufacture of transformer bushings. We work with renowned international companies in the fields of energy generation, transmission, and distribution. Our high-voltage bushings are among the best in the world. As a production engineer, you will play a key role in increasing operational efficiency, ensuring the highest quality standards, and leading groundbreaking projects that will shape the future of our production.  How you'll make an impact  Ensuring maximum plant availability through close cooperation with maintenance and suppliers  Leading projects to optimize throughput times and reduce quality-related costs  Conducting pilot studies to define optimal process parameters and promote continuous improvement  Taking the lead in commissioning new processes and equipment, including defining action plans and training for maintenance and production teams  Evaluating innovative process technologies to improve quality, productivity, and cost efficiency  Investigating process deviations and implementing effective corrective measures  You will actively contribute to the digitalization of production and increasing automation  Leading industrialization projects from planning to successful implementation  Your background  Completed technical degree (ETH\/FH) in production sciences (MTEC), electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, automation technology, or a comparable field  Solid professional experience in the mechanization and automation of production processes and systems, as well as knowledge of high-voltage technology, are an advantage  Experience in technical documentation and work planning to ensure smooth operations  Extensive knowledge in the application of quality methods and tools (e.g., 8D, Ishikawa, moderation techniques)  Very good German language skills (spoken and written) and English language skills at C1 level to operate in an international environment  Confident manner and strong communication and leadership skills to motivate and inspire teams  More about us  We are a technology-driven company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing. 
• We offer dedicated mentorship and a supportive, inclusive environment where you can grow personally and professionally – empowering you to thrive while balancing life and work.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Il nostro gruppo di prodotti Insulation & Components è il leader del mercato tecnico nello sviluppo e nella produzione di boccole per trasformatori. Lavoriamo con aziende internazionali rinomate nei settori della generazione, della trasmissione e della distribuzione di energia. Le nostre boccole ad alta tensione sono tra le migliori al mondo. Come ingegnere di produzione, si svolgerà un ruolo chiave nell'aumento dell'efficienza operativa, assicurando i più elevati standard di qualità, e i principali progetti innovativi che modellano il futuro della nostra produzione. Condurre studi pilota per definire parametri di processo ottimali e promuovere il miglioramento continuo Prendendo il vantaggio di commissionare nuovi processi e attrezzature, tra cui la definizione di piani d'azione e la formazione per i team di manutenzione e produzione Valutare tecnologie di processo innovative per migliorare la qualità, la produttività e l'efficienza dei costi Contribuirai attivamente alla digitalizzazione della produzione e all'aumentare dell'automazione Progetti di industrializzazione leader dalla pianificazione all'implementazione di successo La tua esperienza tecnica completa (ETH\/FH) nelle scienze di produzione (MTEC), ingegneria elettrica, ingegneria meccanica, tecnologia di automazione, o un campo comparabile Esperienza professionale solida nella meccanizzazione e nell'automazione dei processi e dei sistemi di produzione, nonché la conoscenza della tecnologia ad alta tensione, sono un vantaggio Esperienza nella documentazione tecnica e nella pianificazione del lavoro per garantire operazioni fluide Molto buone competenze linguistiche tedesche (spoken e scritto) e competenze linguistiche in inglese a livello C1 per operare in un ambiente internazionale Confidente modo e forti capacità di comunicazione e leadership per motivare e ispirare i team.
• Offriamo una mentorship dedicata e un ambiente di supporto e inclusivo in cui si può crescere personalmente e professionalmente – consentendo di prosperare mentre si bilancia la vita e il lavoro.

jobs.title: Senior Expert in Energy System Modelling and Advanced Power System Analysis
jobs.description: The Opportunity At Hitachi Energy, you help define how future power systems will be planned, built, and operated. As Senior Expert in Energy System Modelling and Advanced Power System Analysis, you play a key role in shaping the company's perspective on the global energy transition. Within the Market Innovation function and the Power Systems of the Future research program, you lead complex analytical work at the intersection of long‑term system planning, market design, and detailed technical grid analysis. You translate disruptive trends such as, renewables, electrification, sector coupling, inverter‑based resources into robust scenarios, advanced models, and actionable insights. This role is designed for a highly experienced technical professional who combines deep analytical expertise with strategic thinking, software proficiency, and the ability to influence peers, stakeholders, and future technology directions. How you'll make an impact Lead development of medium‑ and long‑term energy transition scenarios Analyze impacts of electrification, hydrogen, storage, and market design Translate policy, technology, and climate drivers into modeling assumptions Advance capacity expansion and system planning methodologies and tools Improve optimization formulations, algorithms, and computational workflows Perform advanced power system studies, including dynamics and fault analysis Assess integration of inverter‑based resources and grid‑forming controls Bridge strategic planning models with detailed technical network studies Your background PhD in Electrical Engineering, Energy Systems, Computer Science, or similar; or MSc with 3+ years of relevant professional experience Deep expertise in energy system modeling and scenario analysis Strong knowledge of mathematical optimization and advanced simulations Proven experience with steady‑state, dynamic, and short‑circuit studies Solid understanding of converter‑dominated and inverter‑based resources Advanced programming skills in Python and MATLAB\/Simulink Hands‑on experience with tools such as PowerFactory, PSS®E, or PSCAD Ability to mentor others and contribute to technical leadership More About Us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptionByLocale.it: Descrizione The Opportunity At Hitachi Energy, aiuta a definire come i sistemi di potenza futuri saranno progettati, costruiti e gestiti. Come Senior Expert in Energy System Modelling e Advanced Power System Analysis, si gioca un ruolo chiave nella definizione della prospettiva dell'azienda sulla transizione energetica globale. All'interno della funzione Market Innovation e dei Power Systems del programma di ricerca Future, si conduce un lavoro analitico complesso all'intersezione di pianificazione del sistema a lungo termine, progettazione del mercato e analisi della griglia tecnica dettagliata. Traduci tendenze distruttive come, rinnovabili, elettrificazione, accoppiamento del settore, risorse basate su inverter in scenari robusti, modelli avanzati e intuizioni attuabili. Questo ruolo è stato progettato per un professionista tecnico altamente esperto che combina competenze analitiche profonde con il pensiero strategico, la competenza del software, e la capacità di influenzare peers, stakeholders e future direzioni tecnologiche. Mansioni - Sviluppo dei requisiti degli scenari di transizione energetica a medio e lungo termine - Analizzare gli impatti dell'elettrificazione, dell'idrogeno, dello stoccaggio e del design del mercato - Tradurre la politica, la tecnologia e i driver climatici nelle ipotesi di modellazione - Analisi di espansione della capacità avanzata e metodi di pianificazione del sistema flessibili - Migliorare le formulazioni di ottimizzazione, gli algoritmi e i flussi di lavoro computazionali.

Ce rôle est conçu pour un professionnel technique hautement expérimenté qui combine une expertise analytique profonde avec la pensée stratégique, la compétence logicielle et la capacité d'influencer les pairs, les intervenants et les orientations technologiques futures. Mansioni - Diriger l'élaboration de scénarios de transition énergétique à moyen et à long terme - Analyser les impacts de l'électrification, de l'hydrogène, du stockage et de la conception du marché - Traduire les facteurs politiques, technologiques et climatiques en hypothèses de modélisation - Développer les capacités avancées et les méthodes et outils de planification des systèmes - Améliorer les formulations d'optimisation, les algorithmes et les flux de travail informatiques - Effectuer des études avancées sur les systèmes d'alimentation électrique, y compris l'analyse de la dynamique et de la faille - Évaluer l'intégration des ressources basées sur l'onduleur et les contrôles de formation des grilles - Passer des modèles de planification stratégique avec des études techniques détaillées sur les réseaux
• Requisiti - PhD en génie électrique, en systèmes énergétiques, en informatique, ou similaire; ou MSc ayant plus de 3 ans d'expérience professionnelle pertinente - Expertise approfondie en modélisation des systèmes d'énergie et en analyse de scénarios - Forte connaissance de l'optimisation mathématique et des simulations avancées - Expérience éprouvée avec des outils tels que PowerFactory, dynamique et court-circuits - Compréhension solide des ressources àdominées et inverter-bas.

jobs.title: Equipment Engineer -Diffusion, 80 – 100% (f/m/d)

You will work in a collaborative environment, contributing to continuous improvement and supporting innovative manufacturing processes.  As a Diffusion Maintenance Engineer, you will play a critical role in ensuring the availability, efficiency, and continuous improvement of semiconductor high temperature production systems. jobs.description: The opportunity To strengthen our engineering team, we are looking for a System Engineer (SCADA\/RTU) to work on control and protection systems in the field of power grid substations. Openness, customer orientation, and innovation are key success factors in our working environment. You should be a team player who collaborates across different organizational levels in an intercultural environment. If you enjoy combining technical expertise with a strong customer focus, this is an opportunity for you! Early-career professionals are also welcome to apply. Welcome to our team! Good English skills are essential; additional languages such as French are an advantage More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

jobs.title: Global SCM Material Sustainability Lead (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity Hitachi Energy is seeking a Global SCM Material Sustainability Lead for the Business Unit Transformers to join our innovative and forward-thinking team. In this role, you will lead the end-to-end management of the Material Sustainability pillar, aligning methodologies for environmental impact assessments, defining processes, implementing initiatives, and monitoring progress across the business unit. This is your opportunity to align with business objectives and regulatory requirements, supporting the organization's sustainability goals and making a meaningful impact in the energy industry. How you will make an impact Contribute to the development of the business unit's supply chain sustainability strategy, focusing on material sustainability and alignment with business objectives. Monitor emerging material sustainability trends, regulatory changes, and customer requirements, integrating them into strategic and operational plans. Develop standardized process flows for material sustainability requirements, ensuring seamless coordination and effective implementation. Identify opportunities to enhance material sustainability, driving projects such as decarbonization efforts and improving practices with key global suppliers. Implement performance monitoring systems to track progress against material sustainability goals, enabling data-driven decisions and continuous improvement. Develop and maintain a comprehensive database of primary sustainability data for materials, ensuring accurate information and promoting adoption across the supply chain. This includes defining the data needed to enable consistent LCA\/EPD\/PCF assessments and comparable material-level impact evaluations. Engage with suppliers and cross-functional teams to guide strategic suppliers toward emission-zero goals and sustainable practices. Develop and deliver training on material sustainability topics, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and best practices across the SCM community. Align the BU Transformers methodologies for assessing material environmental impacts in line with evolving LCA\/EPD standards. Apply these methodologies to transformer-relevant materials and decisions by defining measurable requirements for suppliers and by supporting internal stakeholders with actionable guidance for material choices, claims, and customer requests. Your background Degree in Environmental Science, Engineering, Supply Chain Management, or a related field. Minimum of 10 years of experience in supply chain management with focus on sustainability, with proven leadership in strategy and roadmap creation, preferably within global or large-scale organizations. Strong expertise in materials sustainability standards such as ISO 14040\/14044, ISO 14067, the Greenhouse Gas Protocol, and related frameworks. Extensive experience with Life Cycle Assessments (LCA), Environmental Product Declarations (EPDs), and implementing global sustainability programs related to materials and suppliers. Strong leadership skills with a track record of developing and executing strategic initiatives in complex, international environments. Excellent communication, presentation, and influencing skills, with the ability to build relationships and inspire change at all organization levels.

descriptionByLocale.it: L'opportunità Hitachi Energy è alla ricerca di un Global SCM Material Sustainability Lead for the Business Unit Transformers per unire il nostro team innovativo e avanzato. In questo ruolo, guiderai la gestione end-to-end del pilastro Sostenibilità dei Materiali, allineando le metodologie per la valutazione dell'impatto ambientale, definendo i processi, implementando iniziative e monitorando i progressi nell'unità aziendale. Questa è la tua opportunità di allineare con gli obiettivi aziendali e i requisiti normativi, sostenere gli obiettivi di sostenibilità dell'organizzazione e fare un impatto significativo nel settore dell'energia. Contribuire allo sviluppo della strategia di sostenibilità della supply chain aziendale, focalizzandosi sulla sostenibilità dei materiali e sull'allineamento con gli obiettivi aziendali. Monitorare le tendenze della sostenibilità dei materiali emergenti, i cambiamenti normativi e i requisiti dei clienti, integrandoli in piani strategici e operativi. Sviluppa flussi di processo standardizzati per i requisiti di sostenibilità dei materiali, garantendo un coordinamento senza soluzione di continuità e un'efficace implementazione. Identificare le opportunità per migliorare la sostenibilità dei materiali, guidare progetti come gli sforzi di decarbonizzazione e migliorare le pratiche con i principali fornitori globali. Implementare sistemi di monitoraggio delle prestazioni per monitorare i progressi contro gli obiettivi di sostenibilità dei materiali, consentendo decisioni basate sui dati e un miglioramento continuo. Sviluppare e mantenere un database completo di dati di sostenibilità primaria per i materiali, garantendo informazioni accurate e promuovendo l'adozione in tutta la supply chain. Ciò include la definizione dei dati necessari per consentire valutazioni LCA\/EPD\/PCF coerenti e valutazioni comparabili di impatto a livello materiale. Impegnarsi con fornitori e team interfunzionali per guidare i fornitori strategici verso gli obiettivi emission-zero e pratiche sostenibili. Sviluppare e fornire formazione su argomenti di sostenibilità materiale, favorendo una cultura di miglioramento continuo e migliori pratiche in tutta la comunità SCM. Allineare le metodologie BU Transformers per la valutazione degli impatti ambientali materiali in linea con gli standard LCA\/EPD in evoluzione. Applicare queste metodologie ai materiali e alle decisioni rilevanti del trasformatore definendo requisiti misurabili per i fornitori e sostenendo le parti interessate interne con una guida attuabile per scelte materiali, reclami e richieste dei clienti. La vostra laurea in Scienze Ambientali, Ingegneria, Gestione della Supply Chain, o un campo relativo. Minimo di 10 anni di esperienza nella gestione della supply chain con particolare attenzione alla sostenibilità, con una consolidata leadership nella creazione di strategia e roadmap, preferibilmente all'interno di organizzazioni globali o su larga scala. Forte competenza in materia di standard di sostenibilità dei materiali come ISO 14040\/14044, ISO 14067, il Greenhouse Gas Protocol e le relative strutture. Ampia esperienza con Life Cycle Assessments (LCA), Environmental Product Declarations (EPDs), e l'implementazione di programmi di sostenibilità globale relativi a materiali e fornitori. Forte capacità di leadership con un track record di sviluppo ed esecuzione di iniziative strategiche in ambienti complessi e internazionali. Ottima comunicazione, presentazione e capacità di influenzare, con la capacità di costruire relazioni e ispirare il cambiamento a tutti i livelli dell'organizzazione.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Hitachi Energy sucht einen Global SCM Material Sustainability Lead für die Business Unit Transformers, um sich unserem innovativen und zukunftsweisenden Team anzuschließen. In dieser Funktion leiten Sie das End-to-End-Management der Säule Materialnachhaltigkeit, richten Methoden für Umweltverträglichkeitsprüfungen aus, definieren Prozesse, implementieren Initiativen und überwachen den Fortschritt in der gesamten Geschäftseinheit. Dies ist Ihre Chance, sich an Geschäftszielen und regulatorischen
• Anforderungen auszurichten, die Nachhaltigkeitsziele des Unternehmens zu unterstützen und einen sinnvollen Einfluss auf die Energiewirtschaft zu erzielen. Beitrag zur Entwicklung der Supply-Chain-Nachhaltigkeitsstrategie der Business Unit, die sich auf die materielle Nachhaltigkeit und die Ausrichtung auf die Geschäftsziele konzentriert. Überwachen Sie aufkommende Nachhaltigkeitstrends, regulatorische Änderungen und Kundenanforderungen und integrieren Sie sie in strategische und operative Pläne. Entwicklung standardisierter Prozessabläufe für die
• Anforderungen der Materialnachhaltigkeit, die eine nahtlose Koordination und effektive Umsetzung gewährleisten. Identifizieren Sie Möglichkeiten zur Verbesserung der Materialnachhaltigkeit, fördern Sie Projekte wie Dekarbonisierungsbemühungen und verbessern Sie Praktiken bei wichtigen globalen Lieferanten. Implementieren Sie Leistungsüberwachungssysteme, um Fortschritte im Vergleich zu wesentlichen Nachhaltigkeitszielen zu verfolgen und datengesteuerte Entscheidungen und kontinuierliche Verbesserungen zu ermöglichen. Entwicklung und Pflege einer umfassenden Datenbank mit primären Nachhaltigkeitsdaten für Materialien, um genaue Informationen zu gewährleisten und die Einführung in der gesamten Lieferkette zu fördern. Dazu gehören die Definition der Daten, die erforderlich sind, um konsistente LCA/EPD/PCF-Bewertungen und vergleichbare Materialfolgenabschätzungen zu ermöglichen. Engagieren Sie sich mit Lieferanten und funktionsübergreifenden Teams, um strategische Lieferanten zu emissionsfreien Zielen und nachhaltigen Praktiken zu führen. Entwicklung und Durchführung von Schulungen zu wesentlichen Nachhaltigkeitsthemen, Förderung einer Kultur der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung und Best Practices in der gesamten SCM-Community. Angleichung der BU Transformers-Methoden zur Bewertung von Umweltauswirkungen im Einklang mit sich entwickelnden LCA/EPD-Standards. Wenden Sie diese Methoden auf transformatorrelevante Materialien und Entscheidungen an, indem Sie messbare
• Anforderungen für Lieferanten definieren und interne Stakeholder mit umsetzbaren Leitlinien für Materialauswahl, Ansprüche und Kundenanfragen unterstützen. Ihr Hintergrundstudium in Environmental Science, Engineering, Supply Chain Management oder einem verwandten Bereich. Mindestens 10 Jahre Erfahrung im Supply Chain Management mit Fokus auf Nachhaltigkeit, mit nachgewiesener Führungsrolle in der Strategie- und Roadmap-Erstellung, vorzugsweise in globalen oder großen Organisationen. Starke Expertise in Nachhaltigkeitsstandards für Materialien wie ISO 14040\/14044, ISO 14067, dem Greenhouse Gas Protocol und verwandten Frameworks. Umfangreiche Erfahrung mit Life Cycle Assessments (LCA), Environmental Product Declarations (EPDs) und der Umsetzung globaler Nachhaltigkeitsprogramme in Bezug auf Materialien und Lieferanten. Starke Führungsqualitäten mit einer Erfolgsbilanz bei der Entwicklung und Durchführung strategischer Initiativen in komplexen, internationalen Umgebungen. Hervorragende Kommunikation, Präsentation und beeinflussende Fähigkeiten, mit der Fähigkeit, Beziehungen aufzubauen und Veränderungen auf allen Organisationsebenen anzuregen.
descriptionByLocale.fr: L'opportunité Hitachi Energy cherche un responsable mondial de la durabilité des matériaux SCM pour les transformateurs de l'unité d'affaires de rejoindre notre équipe innovante et prospective. Dans ce rôle, vous dirigerez la gestion de bout en bout du pilier Développement durable des matériaux, en alignant les méthodes d'évaluation des impacts environnementaux, en définissant les processus, en mettant en oeuvre des initiatives et en surveillant les progrès dans l'ensemble de l'unité opérationnelle. C'est l'occasion pour vous de vous conformer aux objectifs opérationnels et aux exigences réglementaires, de soutenir les objectifs de durabilité de l'organisation et d'avoir un impact significatif dans l'industrie de l'énergie. Comment vous allez avoir un impact Contribuer à l'élaboration de la stratégie de durabilité de la chaîne d'approvisionnement de l'unité, en mettant l'accent sur la durabilité matérielle et l'alignement sur les objectifs opérationnels. Surveiller les nouvelles tendances en matière de durabilité matérielle, les changements réglementaires et les exigences des clients, en les intégrant dans les plans stratégiques et opérationnels. Élaborer des processus normalisés pour répondre aux besoins en matière de durabilité matérielle, en assurant une coordination transparente et une mise en oeuvre efficace. Identifier les possibilités d'améliorer la durabilité matérielle, de conduire des projets tels que les efforts de décarbonisation et d'améliorer les pratiques avec les principaux fournisseurs mondiaux. Mettre en place des systèmes de suivi des résultats pour suivre les progrès accomplis par rapport aux objectifs de durabilité matérielle, en permettant de prendre des décisions fondées sur les données et d'améliorer continuellement les résultats. Mettre au point et tenir à jour une base de données exhaustive sur la durabilité primaire des matériaux, en veillant à ce que l'information soit exacte et en encourageant l'adoption dans toute la chaîne d'approvisionnement. Il s'agit notamment de définir les données nécessaires pour permettre la réalisation d'évaluations cohérentes de la LCA\/EPD\/PCF et d'évaluations d'impact comparables au niveau matériel. Collaborer avec les fournisseurs et les équipes interfonctionnelles pour guider les fournisseurs stratégiques vers des objectifs zéro émission et des pratiques durables. Élaborer et dispenser une formation sur des sujets liés à la durabilité matérielle, en favorisant une culture d'amélioration continue et de pratiques exemplaires dans la collectivité de MSC. Aligner les méthodes de transformation de l'UB pour l'évaluation des impacts environnementaux des matériaux conformément aux normes de LCA\/EPD en évolution. Appliquer ces méthodes aux documents et décisions pertinents pour les transformateurs en définissant des exigences mesurables pour les fournisseurs et en appuyant les intervenants internes en leur fournissant des directives pratiques pour les choix matériels, les réclamations et les demandes des clients. Diplôme en sciences de l'environnement, en génie, en gestion de la chaîne d'approvisionnement ou dans un domaine connexe. Au moins 10 ans d'expérience dans la gestion de la chaîne d'approvisionnement en mettant l'accent sur la durabilité, avec un leadership prouvé dans la création de stratégies et de feuilles de route, de préférence au sein des organisations mondiales ou à grande échelle. Forte expertise en matière de normes de durabilité des matériaux, telles que ISO 14067, ISO 14044, le Protocole sur les gaz à effet de serre et les cadres connexes. Expérience approfondie des évaluations du cycle de vie, des déclarations de produits environnementaux et de la mise en oeuvre de programmes mondiaux de durabilité liés aux matériaux et aux fournisseurs. De solides compétences en leadership avec une expérience de développement et d'exécution d'initiatives stratégiques dans des environnements internationaux complexes. Excellente communication, présentation et influence des compétences, avec la capacité d'établir des relations et d'inspirer le changement à tous les niveaux de l'organisation.

descriptionByLocale.it: The opportunity We are looking for a research scientist with expertise in modelling and simulation of complex physical phenomena to join our Research Center in Baden\/Switzerland. In an interdisciplinary environment, you will drive cutting-edge innovation and develop new solutions to improve the performance and reliability of power grids devices, such as transformers, circuit breakers, power semiconductors. Seize this unique opportunity and join our motivated team to contribute to a sustainable energy future for all! How you'll make an impact You innovate: Drive the translation of innovative ideas into new power grid device features through physical modeling, scientific programming, and advanced data analysis You investigate: Elaborate and implement new models to improve the understanding of physical phenomena, such as electromagnetic, fluid-dynamics, mechanical and nonlinear material behavior You take initiative: Collaborate with a global and interdisciplinary team of researchers and engineers across research and business units to identify, shape, and solve impactful industrial challenges You collaborate: Build relationships within the company and actively share your knowledge and expertise. Interact with local and global external partners including universities and vendors You communicate: Disseminate your results in scientific publications, patent applications, and technical reports Your background PhD in physics with strong theoretical background or in applied mathematics Proven expertise in collaborative software development, visualization and working with large code bases Practical experience with usage of simulation software and tools for engineering problems Proven track record at top scientific conferences and journal publications Excellent communication skills in English, team player attitude, initiative and creativity More about us At Hitachi Energy, we believe in the power of diversity and the potential of every person. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. We invite you to apply and join us in shaping a sustainable future. Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

jobs.title: Project Manager – Process Improvement 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity  Hitachi Energy is looking for a dynamic and experienced Project Manager Process Improvement to drive strategic optimization initiatives across business units. In this role, you will enhance efficiency, reduce costs, and strengthen overall operational performance through structured process improvements and digital transformation.  How you'll make an impact  Lead end-to-end process improvement projects using Lean, Six Sigma, and A3 methodologies   Define project scope, objectives, deliverables, and success metrics with stakeholders   Analyse current processes to identify inefficiencies and improvement opportunities   Develop and implement scalable process solutions leveraging best practices and digital tools and drive change management, including workshops and trainings to ensure adoption   Lead CI method trainings (e.g. A3 problem solving)  Monitor project progress, risks, and performance, and report to senior management   Collaborate cross-functionally with operations, finance, IT, and other stakeholders   Identify opportunities for automation, digitalization, and continuous improvement  Your background  Bachelor's degree in business administration, Engineering, or a related field (Master's is a plus)   Minimum 5 years of experience in project management with focus on process improvement   Minimum 3 year of experience as continues improvement responsible  Proven track record in delivering complex process optimization initiatives  Lean Six Sigma (Green\/Black Belt) certification   Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a data-driven mindset Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills   Experience working in cross-functional and international environments  Ability to adapt in a fast-paced and evolving business environment  English is mandatory, German beneficial More about us   Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptionByLocale.it: L'opportunità Hitachi Energy è alla ricerca di un Project Manager dinamico ed esperto di miglioramento dei processi per guidare iniziative di ottimizzazione strategica tra le unità aziendali. In questo ruolo migliorerai l'efficienza, ridurrai i costi e rafforzerai le prestazioni operative complessive attraverso miglioramenti strutturati dei processi e trasformazione digitale. Come avrai un impatto Condurre progetti di miglioramento dei processi end-to-end utilizzando le metodologie Lean, Six Sigma e A3 Definire l'ambito del progetto, gli obiettivi, i risultati finali e le metriche di successo con le parti interessate Analizzare i processi attuali per identificare inefficienze e opportunità di miglioramento Sviluppare e implementare soluzioni di processo scalabili sfruttando le migliori pratiche e strumenti digitali e guidare la gestione del cambiamento, inclusi workshop e corsi di formazione per garantire l'adozione Condurre corsi di formazione sul metodo CI (ad esempio risoluzione di problemi A3) Monitorare i progressi, i rischi e le prestazioni del progetto e riferire a dirigenti senior Collaborare in modo interfunzionale con operazioni, finanza, IT e altre parti interessate Identificare opportunità di automazione, digitalizzazione e miglioramento continuo Il tuo background Laurea in economia aziendale, ingegneria o un campo correlato (il master è un plus) Minimo 5 anni di esperienza nella gestione di progetti con particolare attenzione al miglioramento dei processi Minimo 3 anni di esperienza come responsabile del miglioramento continuo Comprovata esperienza nella realizzazione di iniziative complesse di ottimizzazione dei processi Certificazione Lean Six Sigma (cintura verde/nera) Forti capacità analitiche e di risoluzione dei problemi con una mentalità basata sui dati Eccellente comunicazione e capacità di gestione degli stakeholder Esperienza di lavoro in ambienti interfunzionali e internazionali Capacità di adattarsi in un ambiente aziendale frenetico e in evoluzione L'inglese è obbligatorio, il tedesco è utile Maggiori informazioni su di noi Le nostre pratiche di lavoro flessibili ti aiutano a ottimizzare le prestazioni personali e aziendali creando al contempo un ambiente in cui tutti i dipendenti possono sviluppare le proprie competenze e crescere.

In this role, you will enhance efficiency, reduce costs, and strengthen overall operational performance through structured process improvements and digital transformation. How you'll make an impact Lead end-to-end process improvement projects using Lean, Six Sigma, and A3 methodologies Define project scope, objectives, deliverables, and success metrics with stakeholders Analyse current processes to identify inefficiencies and improvement opportunities Develop and implement scalable process solutions leveraging best practices and digital tools and drive change management, including workshops and trainings to ensure adoption Lead CI method trainings (e.g. A3 problem solving) Monitor project progress, risks, and performance, and report to senior management Collaborate cross-functionally with operations, finance, IT, and other stakeholders Identify opportunities for automation, digitalization, and continuous improvement Your background Bachelor's degree in business administration, Engineering, or a related field (Master's is a plus) Minimum 5 years of experience in project management with focus on process improvement Minimum 3 year of experience as continues improvement responsible Proven track record in delivering complex process optimization initiatives Lean Six Sigma (Green\/Black Belt) certification Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a data-driven mindset Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills Experience working in cross-functional and international environments Ability to adapt in a fast-paced and evolving business environment English is mandatory, German beneficial More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.
descriptionByLocale.de: Die Gelegenheit: Hitachi Energy sucht einen dynamischen und erfahrenen Projektmanager für Prozessverbesserung, um strategische Optimierungsinitiativen in allen Geschäftsbereichen voranzutreiben. In dieser Rolle steigern Sie die Effizienz, senken Kosten und stärken die Gesamtbetriebsleistung durch strukturierte Prozessverbesserungen und digitale Transformation. Wie Sie etwas bewirken werden Leiten Sie End-to-End-Prozessverbesserungsprojekte mit Lean-, Six Sigma- und A3-Methoden. Definieren Sie Projektumfang, Ziele, Ergebnisse und Erfolgskennzahlen mit Stakeholdern. Analysieren Sie aktuelle Prozesse, um Ineffizienzen und Verbesserungsmöglichkeiten zu identifizieren. Entwickeln und implementieren Sie skalierbare Prozesslösungen unter Nutzung von Best Practices und digitalen Tools und treiben Sie das Änderungsmanagement voran, einschließlich Workshops und Schulungen, um die Akzeptanz sicherzustellen. Leiten Sie CI-Methodenschulungen (z. B. A3-Problemlösung). Überwachen Sie Projektfortschritt, Risiken und Leistung und erstellen Sie Berichte an die Geschäftsleitung Arbeiten Sie funktionsübergreifend mit Betrieb, Finanzen, IT und anderen Interessengruppen zusammen Identifizieren Sie Möglichkeiten für Automatisierung, Digitalisierung und kontinuierliche Verbesserung Ihr Hintergrund Bachelor-Abschluss in Betriebswirtschaft, Ingenieurwesen oder einem verwandten Bereich (Master ist ein Plus) Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung im Projektmanagement mit Schwerpunkt auf Prozessverbesserung Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung als Verantwortlicher für kontinuierliche Verbesserung Nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz bei der Umsetzung komplexer Prozessoptimierungsinitiativen Lean Six Sigma-Zertifizierung (Green/Black Belt) Starke Analyse- und Problemlösungsfähigkeiten mit datengesteuerter Denkweise Ausgezeichnete Kommunikations- und Stakeholder-Managementfähigkeiten Erfahrung in der Arbeit in funktionsübergreifenden und internationalen Umgebungen Fähigkeit, sich an ein schnelllebiges und sich entwickelndes Geschäftsumfeld anzupassen Englisch ist obligatorisch, Deutsch von Vorteil Mehr über uns Unsere flexiblen Arbeitspraktiken helfen Ihnen, die persönliche und geschäftliche Leistung zu optimieren und gleichzeitig ein Umfeld zu schaffen, in dem alle Mitarbeiter ihre Fähigkeiten entwickeln und wachsen können.
descriptionByLocale.fr: L'opportunité Hitachi Energy est à la recherche d'un chef de projet d'amélioration des processus dynamique et expérimenté pour mener des initiatives d'optimisation stratégique dans toutes les unités commerciales. Dans ce rôle, vous améliorerez l'efficacité, réduirez les coûts et renforcerez la performance opérationnelle globale grâce à des améliorations de processus structurés et à la transformation numérique. Comment vous aurez un impact Diriger des projets d'amélioration des processus de bout en bout à l'aide des méthodologies Lean, Six Sigma et A3 Définir la portée du projet, les objectifs, les livrables et les indicateurs de réussite avec les parties prenantes Analyser les processus actuels pour identifier les inefficacités et les opportunités d'amélioration Développer et mettre en œuvre des solutions de processus évolutives tirant parti des meilleures pratiques et des outils numériques et piloter la gestion du changement, y compris des ateliers et des formations pour garantir l'adoption. à la haute direction Collaborer de manière interfonctionnelle avec les opérations, les finances, l'informatique et d'autres parties prenantes Identifier les opportunités d'automatisation, de numérisation et d'amélioration continue Votre expérience Baccalauréat en administration des affaires, en ingénierie ou dans un domaine connexe (la maîtrise est un plus) Minimum de 5 ans d'expérience en gestion de projet avec un accent sur l'amélioration des processus Minimum de 3 ans d'expérience en tant que responsable de l'amélioration continue Expérience avérée dans la mise en œuvre d'initiatives complexes d'optimisation de processus Certification Lean Six Sigma (ceinture verte/noire) Solides compétences analytiques et de résolution de problèmes avec un état d'esprit axé sur les données Excellente communication et compétences en gestion des parties prenantes Expérience de travail dans des environnements interfonctionnels et internationaux Capacité à s'adapter dans un environnement commercial en évolution rapide L'anglais est obligatoire, l'allemand est bénéfique En savoir plus sur nous Nos pratiques de travail flexibles vous aident à optimiser les performances personnelles et professionnelles tout en créant un environnement où tous les employés peuvent développer leurs compétences et grandir.

jobs.title: Structural Mechanical Design Engineer 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity Join our Dry Transformer Engineering team and play a pivotal role in the development of advanced transformer technologies that elevate safety, efficiency, and sustainability across critical power networks. In this position, you will collaborate with cross‑functional partners — including R&D, Production, Quality, and Supply Chain — to translate complex customer requirements into reliable, manufacturable engineering solutions.  How you'll make an impact Conduct structural analysis by hand calculations and finite element simulations on electrical machines for a variety of load cases (e.g. lifting, seismic, short circuit, shock, fatigue etc.) Perform experimental test for the validation of finite element models through comparison with experimental results Conduct experimental testing campaign for the diagnostic of structure-borne and air-borne noise of electrical equipment Ensure that all structural designs complie with relevant industry codes, standards and regulations Prepare detailed structural reports to be delivered to our customers Assist the design engineers in the development of transformer and reactors structural components Support other departments in preparing for customer technical meetings and design reviews Your background Master's degree in mechanical engineering or similar field Proficiency with numerical and analytical calculation software such as ANSYS, nCode, Fluent, MATLAB Knowledge of relevant building codes (Eurocode) and regulations Experience with noise and vibration measurements and relevant data post-processing Work experience in the transformer industry as well as knowledge of transformer manufacturing process, assembly procedures and best practices is a plus Experience with CAD software such as CREO and Inventor is an advantage Ability to communicate effectively in English, both verbally and written Ability to work effectively both individually and in a team More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

Descrizione-Collaborare con partner funzionali incrociati, tra cui R&D, Produzione, Qualità e Catena di fornitura, per tradurre le complesse richieste dei clienti in soluzioni ingegneristiche affidabili e prodotti. - Svolgere analisi strutturale medio calcoli manuali e simulazioni di elementi finiti su macchine elettriche per una varietà di casi di carico (ad esempio sollievo, sismico, cortocircuito, shock, pratica, ecc.) - Eseguire test sperimentali per la validazione dei modelli di elementi finiti attraverso la comparazione con i risultati sperimentali Condurre una campagna di test sperimentali per la diagnosi del rumore e vibrazioni di strutture e aria di apparecchiature elettriche - Assicurarsi che tutti i progetti strutturali siano conformi ai codici e standard dell'industria pertinenti - Preparare relazioni strutturali dettagliate da consegnare ai nostri clienti - Assistere gli ingegneri di progetto nella creazione di componenti strutturali di trasformatori e reattori - Supportare altri dipartimenti nella preparazione di riunioni tecniche e recensioni di progetto con i clienti

descriptionByLocale.de:
Beschreibung: Wir arbeiten mit hochqualifizierten Funktionspartnern zusammen und arbeiten an Forschung und Entwicklung, Produktion, Qualität und Lieferketten, um unseren Kunden die umfassendsten Lösungen zu bieten, mit denen sie zufrieden sind und Produkte herstellen. - Führen Sie eine umfassende Analyse der Struktur von Handbüchern und Simulationen endlicher Elemente auf Ihrer elektrischen Maschine für eine Vielzahl von Fahrzeuggehäusen durch (z. B. Härte, Härte, Kurzschluss, Schock, Schlagkraft usw.). Experimentelle Ergebnisse – Erstellen Sie eine experimentelle Testkampagne für die Diagnose von Gerüchten und Vibrationen von Strukturen und Geräten für elektrische Geräte – Stellen Sie sicher, dass alle und geplanten Strukturen den Kodizes und relevanten Industriestandards entsprechen – Bereiten Sie Strukturrelationen vor Details zur Auftragserteilung an unsere Kunden - Unterstützen Sie Ingenieure bei der Erstellung von Projekten bei der Erstellung von Komponenten, Strukturen von Transformatoren und Umbauten - Unterstützen Sie andere Abteilungen bei der Vorbereitung technischer Zusammenschlüsse und Rezensionen von Projekten mit Kunden.
• Anforderungen - Magistrale Auszeichnung als Ingenieur oder Mechaniker Ähnliches: Kompetenz in der Software zur numerischen Berechnung und Analyse wie ANSYS, nCode, Fluent, MATLAB – Kenntnisse über relevante Code-Gebäude (Eurocode) und Normen – Erfahrungen mit Gerüchten, Vibrationen und relativen Ausarbeitungen von Daten – Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit der Transformations- und Industriebranche Produktions-, Montage- und Praxiskompetenz - CAD-Kompetenz mit CREO und Erfinder (Vorsprung) - Fähigkeit zur effizienten Kommunikation auf Englisch, mündlich für den Autor - Fähigkeit zur effektiven Arbeit, die ich persönlich in einem Team vertrete - Arbeitspraxis Sie sind flexibel, um Ihre persönlichen und persönlichen Wünsche zu erfüllen und ein Ambiente zu schaffen, in dem Sie alle Ihre Fähigkeiten verbessern und steigern können.
descriptionByLocale.fr: Description - Collaborez avec des partenaires en croissance fonctionnelle, dans le domaine de la R&D, de la production, de la qualité et du secteur des fournitures, pour traiter la totalité des plus riches clients en solutions techniques d'affiliation et de produits. - Analyser la structure des calories manuellement et simuler les éléments finis sur votre machine électrique pour une variété de cas de consommation (par exemple sollevation, sismique, circuit court, choc, fatigue, etc.) - Effectuer des tests expérimentaux pour la validation des modèles d'éléments finis lors de la comparaison avec eux résultats expérimentaux - Effectuer une campagne de tests expérimentaux pour le diagnostic des rumeurs et des vibrations de la structure et de l'air des appareils électriques - Assicurarsi che tous les projets de structure siano conformi ai codici e standard dell'industria pertinenti - Préparer les relations structurelles détaillées de l'expédition chez nos clients - Assister les ingénieurs de projet dans la création de composants structurels de transformation et de restauration - Supporter d'autres divisions dans la préparation des réunions techniques et les évaluations de projet avec les clients Conditions requises - Laurea magistrale en ingénierie mécanique ou camp similaire - Compétence avec les logiciels de calcul numérique et analytique comme ANSYS, nCode, Fluent, MATLAB - Connaissance des codes d'édifices pertinents (Eurocode) et normatif - Expérience avec la mise en œuvre des rumeurs et des vibrations et l'élaboration relative des données - Expérience laborieuse dans l'industrie des transformateurs et connaissance du processus de production, d'assemblage et de meilleures pratiques - Compétence avec les logiciels de CAO comme CREO et Inventor (avantage) - Capacité à communiquer efficacement en anglais, si verbalement que par écrit - Capacité à travailler efficacement si individuellement dans une équipe nous offrons - Pratique du travail flexible pour optimiser le rendu personnel et professionnel et créer un environnement dans tout ce que vous faites Vous pourrez acquérir des compétences et grandir.

descriptionByLocale.it: The Opportunity As an GPG Insulation & Components APQP Leader you will be responsible for the implementation and maintenance of Foundation APQP essentials, according to the defined strategy and plan for GPG I&C Quality. You will collaborate with crossfunctional teams ensuring that Foundation APQP essentials are updated according to novelties and new risks. How you´ll make an impact Coordinate the development of Foundation APQP plan. Lead foundation APQP Plan related meetings, collecting and preparing documentation, being main connection point between QMT, Factories, Global experts and R&D. Participate in Foundation FMEA workshops and s upport HUBs and Factories to use foundation APQP essentials (to be cascaded to local products). Support R&D organization to use foundation APQP essentials for new product developments. Support ToT projects to ensure proper transfer of APQP essentials. Act as GPG I&C Plato Admin, train crossfunctional teams, support the organization on the usage and ensure that foundation content is updated . Proactive identification of technology novelties to drive updates in foundation APQP essentials and c ollaborate with GPG Operations to identify global process changes that might affect to foundation APQP essentials ( e.g. from best practices to requirement). Your b ackground Technical degree from the University . 3-5 years of experience with APQP ( preferably in industries like Automotive or Wind). Strong knowledge of APQP processes, FMEA, PPAP, SPC, and MSA methodologies. Experience with Plato is an advatage . Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify and implement process improvements. Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams and facilitate effective collaboration among diverse stakeholders. Fluency in English What w e o ffer Collective agreement and flexible working hours. Health care and wellness allowance. Career opportunities within Hitachi Energ y, locally and globally. Mentor support during onboarding. Training and development programs. A diverse workplace with 70+ nationalities in Sweden. Supplementary parental leave compensation. Access to an Employee Benefit Portal with discounts. More a bout u s At Hitachi Energy, you'll work in an exciting, collaborative environment delivering world-class technology. We value personal development and diversity, and we are committed to building a sustainable energy future. We are growing and welcome applicants who may not meet every requirement—your potential matters. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so don't wait—apply today! For questions about the position, contact Recruiting Manager Yolanda Villaseca at yolanda.villaseca@hitachienergy.com . jobs.title: Project Manager Product Implementation 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity In this role, you will take ownership of the successful implementation of new and transferred products, ensuring they are ready for market launch and customer installation. You will play a key role in aligning cross-functional teams, driving operational readiness, and ensuring high-quality execution across engineering, procurement, production, and delivery. This position offers a dynamic environment where you can shape processes, drive continuous improvement, and contribute directly to the success of innovative GIS products. How you'll make an impact Lead end-to-end product implementation projects from initiation to closure Define scope, objectives, and deliverables with key stakeholders Develop and manage project plans, timelines, resources, and budgets Align and coordinate cross-functional teams to ensure execution readiness Ensure completeness and accuracy of master data across all systems Monitor early production phases (test objects and zero series) to validate readiness Identify risks, drive mitigation actions, and ensure transparent communication Track production, assembly, and testing processes and drive continuous improvement Your background Bachelor's degree in engineering, business administration, or a related field Minimum 5 years of project management experience, ideally in product implementation Proven experience delivering complex technical or industrial projects Strong knowledge of project management methodologies (e.g., Agile, Waterfall) Experience working in cross-functional and international environments Solid understanding of industrial product lifecycles; GIS experience is a plus Strong communication and stakeholder management skills PMP certification and knowledge of tools like MS Project or Jira are advantageous More about us   Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptionByLocale.it: L'opportunità In questo ruolo, assumerai la responsabilità dell'implementazione di successo di prodotti nuovi e trasferiti, assicurandoti che siano pronti per il lancio sul mercato e l'installazione da parte del cliente. Svolgerai un ruolo chiave nell'allineamento dei team interfunzionali, nella promozione della prontezza operativa e nel garantire un'esecuzione di alta qualità nei settori di ingegneria, approvvigionamento, produzione e consegna. Questa posizione offre un ambiente dinamico in cui è possibile modellare i processi, promuovere il miglioramento continuo e contribuire direttamente al successo di prodotti GIS innovativi. Come avrai un impatto Guidare progetti di implementazione del prodotto end-to-end dall'inizio alla chiusura Definire ambito, obiettivi e risultati finali con le principali parti interessate Sviluppare e gestire piani di progetto, tempistiche, risorse e budget Allineare e coordinare team interfunzionali per garantire la preparazione all'esecuzione Garantire la completezza e l'accuratezza dei dati master in tutti i sistemi Monitorare le prime fasi di produzione (oggetti di test e serie zero) per convalidare la preparazione Identificare i rischi, promuovere azioni di mitigazione e garantire una comunicazione trasparente Monitorare i processi di produzione, assemblaggio e test e promuovere il miglioramento continuo background Laurea in ingegneria, amministrazione aziendale o un campo correlato Minimo 5 anni di esperienza nella gestione di progetti, idealmente nell'implementazione del prodotto Comprovata esperienza nella realizzazione di progetti tecnici o industriali complessi Forte conoscenza delle metodologie di gestione dei progetti (ad es. Agile, Waterfall) Esperienza di lavoro in ambienti interfunzionali e internazionali Solida comprensione dei cicli di vita dei prodotti industriali; L'esperienza GIS è un vantaggio Forti capacità di comunicazione e gestione delle parti interessate La certificazione PMP e la conoscenza di strumenti come MS Project o Jira sono vantaggiose Maggiori informazioni su di noi Le nostre pratiche di lavoro flessibili ti aiutano a ottimizzare le prestazioni personali e aziendali creando al contempo un ambiente in cui tutti i dipendenti possono sviluppare le proprie competenze e crescere.

descriptionByLocale.de: Die Chance: In dieser Rolle übernehmen Sie die Verantwortung für die erfolgreiche Implementierung neuer und übertragener Produkte und stellen sicher, dass diese für die Markteinführung und Installation beim Kunden bereit sind. Sie spielen eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Ausrichtung funktionsübergreifender Teams, der Förderung der Betriebsbereitschaft und der Sicherstellung einer qualitativ hochwertigen Ausführung in den Bereichen Technik, Beschaffung, Produktion und Lieferung. Diese Position bietet ein dynamisches Umfeld, in dem Sie Prozesse gestalten, kontinuierliche Verbesserungen vorantreiben und direkt zum Erfolg innovativer GIS-Produkte beitragen können. Wie Sie etwas bewirken werden Leiten Sie End-to-End-Produktimplementierungsprojekte von der Initiierung bis zum Abschluss. Definieren Sie Umfang, Ziele und Ergebnisse mit den wichtigsten Stakeholdern. Entwickeln und verwalten Sie Projektpläne, Zeitpläne, Ressourcen und Budgets. Richten Sie funktionsübergreifende Teams aus und koordinieren Sie sie, um die Ausführungsbereitschaft sicherzustellen. Stellen Sie die Vollständigkeit und Genauigkeit der Stammdaten in allen Systemen sicher. Überwachen Sie frühe Produktionsphasen (Testobjekte und Nullserien), um die Bereitschaft zu validieren. Identifizieren Sie Risiken, treiben Sie Abhilfemaßnahmen voran und stellen Sie eine transparente Kommunikation sicher. Verfolgen Sie Produktions-, Montage- und Testprozesse und treiben Sie kontinuierliche Verbesserungen voran Hintergrund Bachelor-Abschluss in Ingenieurwissenschaften, Betriebswirtschaft oder einem verwandten Bereich Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung im Projektmanagement, idealerweise in der Produktimplementierung Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der Durchführung komplexer technischer oder industrieller Projekte Umfangreiche Kenntnisse der Projektmanagementmethoden (z. B. Agile, Wasserfall) Erfahrung in der Arbeit in funktionsübergreifenden und internationalen Umgebungen Solides Verständnis der Lebenszyklen industrieller Produkte; GIS-Erfahrung ist von Vorteil. Starke Kommunikations- und Stakeholder-Managementfähigkeiten. PMP-Zertifizierung und Kenntnisse von Tools wie MS Project oder Jira sind von Vorteil. Mehr über uns. Unsere flexiblen Arbeitspraktiken helfen Ihnen, die persönliche und geschäftliche Leistung zu optimieren und gleichzeitig ein Umfeld zu schaffen, in dem alle Mitarbeiter ihre Fähigkeiten entwickeln und wachsen können.
descriptionByLocale.fr: L'opportunité Dans ce rôle, vous prendrez en charge la mise en œuvre réussie des produits nouveaux et transférés, en vous assurant qu'ils sont prêts pour le lancement sur le marché et l'installation chez le client. Vous jouerez un rôle clé dans l’alignement des équipes interfonctionnelles, dans la préparation opérationnelle et dans la garantie d’une exécution de haute qualité en matière d’ingénierie, d’approvisionnement, de production et de livraison. Ce poste offre un environnement dynamique dans lequel vous pouvez façonner les processus, conduire une amélioration continue et contribuer directement au succès des produits SIG innovants. Comment vous aurez un impact Diriger des projets de mise en œuvre de produits de bout en bout, du lancement à la clôture Définir la portée, les objectifs et les livrables avec les principales parties prenantes Développer et gérer les plans, les délais, les ressources et les budgets du projet Aligner et coordonner les équipes interfonctionnelles pour assurer la préparation à l'exécution Assurer l'exhaustivité et l'exactitude des données de référence sur tous les systèmes Surveiller les premières phases de production (objets de test et séries zéro) pour valider l'état de préparation Identifier les risques, piloter les actions d'atténuation et assurer une communication transparente Suivre les processus de production, d'assemblage et de test et favoriser l'amélioration continue Votre parcours Baccalauréat en ingénierie, administration des affaires ou domaine connexe Minimum de 5 ans d'expérience en gestion de projet, idéalement dans la mise en œuvre de produits Expérience avérée dans la réalisation de projets techniques ou industriels complexes Solide connaissance des méthodologies de gestion de projet (par exemple, Agile, Waterfall) Expérience de travail dans des environnements interfonctionnels et internationaux Solide compréhension des cycles de vie des produits industriels ; Une expérience SIG est un plus De solides compétences en communication et en gestion des parties prenantes La certification PMP et la connaissance d'outils comme MS Project ou Jira sont un avantage. En savoir plus sur nous Nos pratiques de travail flexibles vous aident à optimiser vos performances personnelles et professionnelles tout en créant un environnement où tous les employés peuvent développer leurs compétences et grandir.

jobs.title: Internship in Project Management 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity Join a collaborative team that values innovation and continuous improvement. In this role, you will support operational excellence and learn how a production unit works. You will gain hands-on experience with data visualization, process optimization, and project support.  The duration of the internship is 6 - 12 months. How you'll make an impact Visualize project and financial status using Visual Basic and Power BI Prepare and present KPI analyses during area meetings Find new ways to optimize information flow between different departments with PowerApps Identify efficiency improvements using lean principles Connect departments and optimize processes for better collaboration Assist project managers with documentation during peak periods Take on additional tasks aligned with your development goals Your background Enrolled or completed Masters or Bachelors degree in a technical field Interest in data collection, processes, and production environments Basic knowledge of Visual Basic, Excel, Power BI\/ PowerApps (or willingness to learn) Good English skills, both, written and spoken Open-minded and proactive personality More about us We are a technology-driven company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing. 
• We offer flexible working conditions, dedicated mentorship, and a supportive, inclusive environment where you can grow personally and professionally – empowering you to thrive while balancing life and work.

jobs.title: Research Team Manager - Circuit Breaker (f/m/d)
jobs.description: We are looking for a passionate Research Team Manager to lead our multidisciplinary Circuit Breaker research team in Baden-Dättwil (Switzerland), part of the Central European Hitachi Energy Research Center. How you'll make an impact   You are a leader Set clear goals and priorities for the team, ensuring alignment with the overall research strategy Encourage a culture of continuous learning and innovation, supporting the team in staying at the forefront of technological advancements Build capabilities and succession within the team: plan capacity, people and resources; coach, mentor and develop engineers; maintain the team as a center of excellence for interrupter technology   You contribute Oversee different research laboratories, ensuring high safety standards and compliance Contribute to research projects and pre-studies with your own scientific expertise Participate in test campaigns, including taking on the electrical emergency first aider role (training will be provided)   You are impactful Foster the creation of new research project proposals and strategic research initiatives Contribute to an innovative, motivating, and inclusive working environment   You foster collaboration Maintain and expand a strong network with relevant business units and leading universities Promote collaboration across all Hitachi Energy Research Centers   Your background   PhD in Physics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field Technical expertise in areas such as circuit breakers, high power testing, plasma physics, along with an interest in emerging research and technology fields Several years of experience and a proven track record in industrial R&D, including people leadership experience Fluency in English (written and spoken); German is an advantage   If you are eager to drive innovation in a dynamic research environment, we look forward to your application!

jobs.title: HSE Manager 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity Are you passionate about creating a safe and sustainable working environment where people can thrive? As our HSE Manager for PSC Switzerland, you will take full ownership of the Health, Safety, and Environment function and play a key role in shaping a strong safety culture across our organization. In this position, you will lead and develop the HSE team while acting as the Site Lead Manager (HSE) for our Training Center in Rüti and Service Logistic Center in Dietlikon. You will collaborate closely with leadership, employees, and external partners to ensure the highest health and safety standards, drive continuous improvement, and make a tangible impact on how we protect our people and operations every day. How you'll make an impact Lead HSE function and team for PSC Switzerland and serve as Site Lead Manager (HSE) for Training Center in Rüti and Service Logistic Center in Dietlikon  Ensure strong commitment to health and safety standards, guidelines, management systems, and procedures  Communicate health and safety initiatives, processes, and procedures to ensure uniform understanding across the organization  Monitor compliance with health and safety requirements and handle non-conformances according to established procedures  Assist and guide management, supervisors, and employees in accident prevention and act as an interface with contractors and clients when needed  Implement and maintain the health and safety management system and ensure quality input where necessary  Conduct safety audits, investigate accidents, identify root causes, and supervise corrective actions  Provide guidance on competency-based health and safety training and lead HSE and Sustainability Reviews for Rüti and Dietlikon, ensuring assurance activities are completed  Your background 5+ years of experience in managerial role in industrial company, preferably in HSE, construction or factory environment  Strong leadership personality and excellent interpersonal and communication skills  Understanding of health and safety in project\/customer sites and the role a safety system plays in managing the overall risk profile of a site  Practical “hands-on” experience in developing and managing safety systems with the ability to dig into site-specific details and develop solutions to complex safety issues  Knowledge about OSHA legislation for construction sites and working experience in Safety-related positions  International experience and intercultural sensitivity and Solutions-oriented personality with strong engagement  Proficiency in English (written and oral), German of advantage and any other language is a plus  Approximately 25% Travel required More about us   Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptionByLocale.de: Die Chance: Sind Sie leidenschaftlich daran interessiert, ein sicheres und nachhaltiges Arbeitsumfeld zu schaffen, in dem sich Menschen entfalten können? Als unser HSE-Manager für PSC Schweiz übernehmen Sie die volle Verantwortung für die Funktion Gesundheit, Sicherheit und Umwelt und spielen eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Gestaltung einer starken Sicherheitskultur in unserer gesamten Organisation. In dieser Position leiten und entwickeln Sie das HSE-Team und fungieren gleichzeitig als Site Lead Manager (HSE) für unser Schulungszentrum in Rüti und das Service Logistic Center in Dietlikon. Sie arbeiten eng mit Führungskräften, Mitarbeitern und externen Partnern zusammen, um höchste Gesundheits- und Sicherheitsstandards zu gewährleisten, kontinuierliche Verbesserungen voranzutreiben und spürbare Auswirkungen darauf zu haben, wie wir unsere Mitarbeiter und Betriebe jeden Tag schützen. So können Sie etwas bewirken: Leiten Sie die HSE-Funktion und das HSE-Team für PSC Schweiz und fungieren Sie als Site Lead Manager (HSE) für das Schulungszentrum in Rüti und das Service-Logistikzentrum in Dietlikon. Sorgen Sie für ein starkes Engagement für Gesundheits- und Sicherheitsstandards, Richtlinien, Managementsysteme und Verfahren. Kommunizieren Sie Gesundheits- und Sicherheitsinitiativen, -prozesse und -verfahren, um ein einheitliches Verständnis in der gesamten Organisation zu gewährleisten. Überwachen Sie die Einhaltung von Gesundheits- und Sicherheitsanforderungen und behandeln Sie Nichtkonformitäten gemäß festgelegten Verfahren. Unterstützen und leiten Sie Management, Vorgesetzte und Mitarbeiter bei der Unfallverhütung und fungieren Sie als Schnittstelle bei Bedarf mit Auftragnehmern und Kunden zusammenarbeiten. Implementieren und pflegen Sie das Gesundheits- und Sicherheitsmanagementsystem und stellen Sie bei Bedarf Qualitätseingaben sicher. Führen Sie Sicherheitsaudits durch, untersuchen Sie Unfälle, identifizieren Sie Grundursachen und überwachen Sie Korrekturmaßnahmen. Bieten Sie Anleitung zu kompetenzbasierten Gesundheits- und Sicherheitsschulungen und leiten Sie HSE- und Nachhaltigkeitsprüfungen für Rüti und Dietlikon, um sicherzustellen, dass die Sicherungsaktivitäten abgeschlossen werden. Ihr Hintergrund. Mehr als 5 Jahre Erfahrung in Führungspositionen in einem Industrieunternehmen, vorzugsweise im HSE-, Bau- oder Fabrikumfeld. Starke Führungspersönlichkeit und ausgezeichnete zwischenmenschliche und kommunikative Fähigkeiten. Verständnis für Gesundheit und Sicherheit an Projekt-/Kundenstandorten und die Rolle, die ein Sicherheitssystem bei der Verwaltung des Gesamtrisikoprofils eines Standorts spielt. Praktische „praktische“ Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und Verwaltung von Sicherheitssystemen mit der Fähigkeit, sich mit standortspezifischen Details zu befassen und Lösungen für komplexe Sicherheitsprobleme zu entwickeln. Kenntnisse über die OSHA-Gesetzgebung für Baustellen und Berufserfahrung in sicherheitsbezogenen Positionen. Internationale Erfahrung und interkulturelle Sensibilität sowie lösungsorientierte Persönlichkeit mit starkem Engagement. Kenntnisse in Englisch (schriftlich und mündlich), Deutsch von Vorteil und jeder anderen Sprache sind von Vorteil. Ungefähr 25 % Reiseaufwand. Mehr darüber Uns Unsere flexiblen Arbeitspraktiken helfen Ihnen, die persönliche und geschäftliche Leistung zu optimieren und gleichzeitig ein Umfeld zu schaffen, in dem alle Mitarbeiter ihre Fähigkeiten entwickeln und wachsen können.
descriptionByLocale.fr: L'opportunité Êtes-vous passionné par la création d'un environnement de travail sûr et durable où les gens peuvent s'épanouir ? En tant que responsable HSE pour PSC Suisse, vous assumerez l'entière responsabilité de la fonction Santé, Sécurité et Environnement et jouerez un rôle clé dans la formation d'une culture de sécurité solide au sein de notre organisation. Dans ce poste, vous dirigerez et développerez l'équipe HSE tout en agissant en tant que Site Lead Manager (HSE) pour notre centre de formation à Rüti et notre centre logistique de services à Dietlikon. Vous collaborerez en étroite collaboration avec la direction, les employés et les partenaires externes pour garantir les normes de santé et de sécurité les plus élevées, favoriser l'amélioration continue et avoir un impact tangible sur la façon dont nous protégeons nos employés et nos opérations au quotidien. jobs.description: The opportunity  This role offers the opportunity to play a key role in shaping the digital transformation and continuous improvement agenda within GCB. As Improvement Project Manager – Data & Digital Analytics, you will work at the intersection of business, data, and technology, driving data driven initiatives that improve operational efficiency, transparency, and decision-making quality. You will design and deliver scalable digital and analytics solutions using modern cloud technologies, enabling standardized KPIs, reliable insights, and sustainable automation. By collaborating closely with business and IT stakeholders, you will directly contribute to measurable performance improvements and support the organization's long-term digital maturity.    How you'll make an impact  Lead digital and continuous improvement projects from concept to rollout and stabilization   Define project scope, milestones, KPIs, governance, and success criteria aligned with business priorities   Ensure data availability, quality, consistency, and compliant usage across GCB   Design and implement cloud based analytics and data processing solutions   Work extensively with Databricks for data ingestion, transformation, analysis, and modeling   Identify process inefficiencies and implement automation to reduce manual effort and cycle times   Enable standardized KPIs and transparent reporting for management decision-making   Proactively manage risks, dependencies, resources, and stakeholder expectations  Your background  Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related STEM field   2- 3 years relevant working experience  Strong data engineering and analytics skills (SQL, relational databases, cloud analytics, Databricks)   Solid understanding of SAP S\/4HANA data  Experience with Microsoft Power Platform (Power BI, Power Apps, Power Automate)   Proven track record delivering digitalization, process automation, and improvement initiatives   Structured, analytical mindset with strong business communication skills   Excellent project management, ownership, and execution focus   Collaborative, proactive, and self-driven with a passion for digital innovation and continuous improvement  Business fluent in English and German    More about us   Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.
