descriptionByLocale.it: Descrizione L'occasione Hitachi Energy, prodotti ad alta tensione, è rinomata in tutto il mondo come specialista per la trasmissione e la distribuzione di energia. La nostra unità Gas isolato Switchgears (GIS), con sede a Zürich-Oerlikon, è attiva nello sviluppo e nella produzione di sistemi di commutazione isolata a gas. Garantiamo l'elevata affidabilità dei nostri sistemi utilizzando strumenti e metodi di sviluppo all'avanguardia. Come Area Sales Manager, prenderete la proprietà di guidare la crescita aziendale all'interno della vostra regione assegnata e plasmare attivamente il nostro successo di mercato. Potrai lavorare a stretto contatto con clienti e partner, posizionando il nostro portafoglio all'avanguardia e fornendo soluzioni che soddisfano requisiti tecnici e commerciali complessi. Entrando nel nostro team internazionale e altamente esperto, si acquisirà approfondimenti nel business ad alta tensione, contribuendo direttamente ai sistemi energetici sostenibili e affidabili. Questo ruolo offre un'opportunità unica per coniugare competenze tecniche con responsabilità commerciale e per dare un impatto tangibile sul futuro dell'energia. Come farai ad avere un impatto - Sviluppare ed eseguire strategie di vendita per la tua regione assegnata, guidare la crescita sostenibile del business e aumentare la quota di mercato all'interno del portafoglio GIS - Costruire, mantenere ed espandere relazioni forti con i clienti chiave, gli EPC e i partner per identificare le opportunità di business e creare valore a lungo termine - Prendere la proprietà del ciclo di vendita completo, dall'identificazione delle opportunità e offrire la preparazione alla negoziazione e la chiusura di accordi di successo - Collaborare a stretto contatto con le parti interessate interne come l'ingegneria, la gestione del progetto e i team di assistenza per fornire soluzioni competitive e orientate al cliente - Analizzare le tendenze del mercato, le esigenze dei clienti e le attività concorrenti per posizionare in modo proattivo il nostro portafoglio e rafforzare la nostra presenza di mercato - Incremento dell'ordine e crescita dei ricavi, garantendo al contempo l'allineamento con gli obiettivi aziendali e le priorità strategiche - Sostenere i clienti in tutto il ciclo di vita dei progetti, assicurando un alto livello di soddisfazione e individuando opportunità per ulteriori affari Il tuo sfondo - una forte comprensione del mercato dell'energia, dell'industria manifatturiera o del business del sistema, idealmente con l'esposizione a sottostazioni o tecnologie di commutazione - Mindset Entrepreneurial con un approccio proattivo e orientato alla soluzione, combinato con la capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente e guidare argomenti in avanti - jobs.title: Technical Buyer 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity Hitachi Energy, High Voltage Products, is renowned worldwide as a specialist for power transmission and distribution. The Service unit is responsible for the worldwide after sales support of generator circuit-breaker (GCB) systems and gas insulated switchgears (GIS), including training, installation and commissioning, scheduled maintenance, added value services, troubleshooting, extensions, retrofits and replacements. As a Technical Buyer, you act as a key interface between Procurement, Engineering, Quality, and our global supplier network. You ensure that technically specified materials, components, and services are clearly defined, technically clarified, qualified, and available in line with project, quality, and delivery requirements. Through close cross‑functional collaboration, you translate engineering requirements into robust sourcing solutions and support supplier qualification and technical alignment. Your role contributes directly to product quality, supply reliability, and operational excellence, enabling Hitachi Energy to deliver innovative and sustainable energy solutions to our customers worldwide. How you'll make an impact Perform technical clarification of materials, drawings, specifications, and engineering changes in close collaboration with Engineering and suppliers Support and coordinate Production Part Approval Process (PPAP) activities, first samples, and supplier qualification processes Conduct technical evaluations of alternative materials, deviation requests, and obsolescence cases Collaborate closely with Strategic and Operational Buyers on supplier- and material-related topics Support the handling of supplier complaints, Non‑Conformity Reports (NCRs), and root cause analyses Support and participate in supplier assessments and technical supplier evaluations, including capability, quality, and process maturity reviews Contribute to supplier performance evaluations together with Quality and Strategic Procurement Ensure accuracy and completeness of material and supplier master data in SAP and act as the technical contact point during supplier escalations Support Service Organization and Project Teams in complex or urgent procurement topics Your background Completed technical education (e.g. Polymechanic, Automation Technician, Mechanical Technician, Design Engineer or similar) 3-5 years experience in technical procurement or SCM‑related roles Strong understanding of technical drawings, Bill of Material and manufacturing processes Experience working with suppliers on technical and quality‑related topics Structured, solution‑oriented, and communicative working style Good German skills and very good English skills SAP knowledge Proactive, structured, and solution-focused working style. Team oriented mindset with strong cross-functional collaboration More about us   Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Hitachi Energy, Prodotti ad alta tensione La nostra azienda è nota a livello mondiale come specialista per la trasmissione e la distribuzione di energia. L'unità di Servizio è responsabile del supporto post-vendita a livello mondiale per i sistemi di circuito-breaker per generatori (GCB) e per le sostanze di commutazione isolate con gas (GIS), compresi la formazione, l'installazione e la commissione, la manutenzione programmata, i servizi di valore aggiunto, la risoluzione dei problemi, gli estensioni, i retrofit e le sostituzioni. Descrizione del ruolo Come Acquirente Tecnico, agirai come interfaccia chiave tra Procurement, Ingegneria, Qualità e la nostra rete globale di fornitori. Assicurerai che i materiali, i componenti e i servizi specificiti tecnologicimente chiaramente definiti, chiariti, qualificati e disponibili in linea con le esigenze dei progetti, della qualità e della consegna. Attraverso una stretta collaborazione interfunzionale, traduirai le esigenze di ingegneria in soluzioni di approvvigionamento robuste e supporterai la qualifica dei fornitori e l'allineamento tecnico. Il tuo ruolo diretto alla qualità dei prodotti, alla affidabilità delle forniture e all'eccellenza operativa, volendo a Hitachi Energy di fornire soluzioni innovative e sostenibili per l'energia ai nostri clienti in tutto il mondo. Come realizzare un impatto - Esegui la chiarificazione tecnica dei materiali, dei disegni, delle specifiche e delle modifiche ingegneristiche in stretta collaborazione con l'Ingegneria e i fornitori. - Supporta e coordina le attività del Processo di Approvazione dei Parti di Produzione (PPAP), le prime prove e i processi di classificazione dei fornitori. - Conduci le necessarie tecniche di materiali alternativi, richieste di deviazione e boss di obsolescenza. - Collabora diretta con gli Acquirenti Strategici e Operativi sui temi relativi ai fornitori e ai materiali. - Supporta l'organizzazione e la gestione delle lamentele dei fornitori, dei Rapporti di Non Conformità (NCR) e delle analisi di causa radice. - Supporta e partecipa alle competenze dei fornitori e alle dirette tecniche dei fornitori, comprese le recensioni della capacità, della qualità e della maturità dei processi. - Contribuisce alle prestazioni dei fornitori insieme con la Qualità e la Procurement Strategica. - Assicura l'accuratezza e la completezza dei dati di master dei materiali e dei fornitori nel SAP e agiscono come punto di contatto tecnico durante le escalazioni dei fornitori. - Supporta l'Organizzazione di Servizio e le Squadre di Progetto in materia di approvvigionamento complessivo o urgenti.
• Requisiti - Educazione tecnica completata (ad esempio Polimematico, Tecnico di Automazione, Tecnico Meccanico, Ingegnere di Progetto o simili) - 3-5 anni di esperienza in approvvigionamento tecnico o ruoli correlati allo SCM - Buona comprensione dei disegni tecnici, della Lista di Materiali e dei processi di produzione - Esperienza nel lavoro con i fornitori su temi tecnici e di qualità - Stile di lavoro strutturato, orientaleto alla soluzione e comunicativo - Buone abilità in tedesco e ottimi livelli di inglese - Conoscenza di SAP - Stile di lavoro proattivo, strutturato e orientale alla soluzione - Mindset orientaleto al team con forte collaborazione interfunzionale Cosa? - Pratiche di lavoro flessibili che ti aiuti a ottimizzare il rendimento personale e professionale e a creare un ambiente in cui tutti gli impiegati possano sviluppare le loro competenze e crescere.

jobs.title: Field Service Technician Power Transformers (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity   Join our dynamic Transformers After Sales team in Zürich, Switzerland, and play a hands-on role in powering the nation! As a key player, you'll be at the forefront of maintaining and enhancing the reliability and longevity of power transformers all across Switzerland. In this role, you'll directly impact the stability of the Swiss electrical grid and get the unique opportunity to work alongside leading companies in the Swiss energy sector.  Every day, you'll tackle new technical challenges, ensure the safe and high-quality execution of critical fieldwork, and proudly represent Hitachi Energy's reputation for technical excellence and customer satisfaction. Step into a position where your expertise truly makes a difference!    How you´ll make an impact Apply and enforce Hitachi Energy safety standards during all onsite operations.  Perform installations, preventive and corrective maintenance, inspections, and overhauls on power transformers in accordance with internal procedures.  Plan, coordinate and optimize field interventions to ensure efficiency and quality.  Identify potential service opportunities and communicate them to the Sales team.  Collaborate closely with customers, project teams, suppliers and other stakeholders, ensuring clear languages.    What would be a plus   Knowledge of electrical wiring and electrical diagrams  Welding skills  Motivation to follow internal training on transformer assembly and field interventions, descriptionByLocale.it: Unisciti al nostro dinamico Transformers After Sales team di Zurigo, Svizzera, e gioca un ruolo pratico nel potere della nazione! Come giocatore chiave, sarete in prima linea nel mantenere e migliorare l'affidabilità e la longevità dei trasformatori di potenza in tutta la Svizzera. In questo ruolo, influenzerai direttamente la stabilità della rete elettrica svizzera e avrai l'opportunità unica di lavorare insieme a aziende leader nel settore energetico svizzero. Ogni giorno affronterai nuove sfide tecniche, garantirai l'esecuzione sicura e di alta qualità del lavoro sul campo critico e rappresenterai con orgoglio la reputazione di Hitachi Energy per l'eccellenza tecnica e la soddisfazione del cliente. Entra in una posizione in cui la tua esperienza fa davvero la differenza! Applicare e far rispettare gli standard di sicurezza Hitachi Energy durante tutte le operazioni in loco. Eseguire installazioni, manutenzione preventiva e correttiva, ispezioni e revisioni sui trasformatori di potenza in conformità con le procedure interne. Pianificare, coordinare e ottimizzare gli interventi sul campo per garantire efficienza e qualità. Identificare potenziali opportunità di servizio e comunicarle al team Vendite. Collabora a stretto contatto con clienti, team di progetto, fornitori e altri stakeholder, garantendo una comunicazione chiara e tempestiva. Contribuire attivamente al miglioramento continuo all'interno dell'organizzazione del servizio. Completa tutti i report, la documentazione e i record di qualità esattamente nel sistema di tracciamento interno. Il vostro fondo certificato federale di competenza (CFC) in meccanica, manutenzione industriale, elettromeccanica, o un campo correlato (ad esempio, fabbro, meccanico, polimeccanico, tecnico di automazione). Almeno 2 anni di esperienza sul campo rilevante è considerato un bene. Volontà di viaggiare attraverso la Svizzera per lunghi periodi (minimo 1 settimana) e occasionalmente lavorare in 2×8 turni. Forte senso di responsabilità e alta consapevolezza dei requisiti di sicurezza. Licenza valida del conducente della categoria B. Buon comando del tedesco, con inglese e francese come lingue di lavoro aggiuntive. jobs.title: Process Engineer BiMOS Backend - Assembly 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity As a global leader in power semiconductor technology, we offer one of the most diverse product portfolios in the industry. Our products include thyristors, diodes, gate turn-off thyristors, integrated gate-commutated thyristors, insulated-gate bipolar transistors, and metal–oxide–semiconductor field-effect transistors. These components are trusted across sectors such as power transmission and distribution, mobility, and renewable energy for their exceptional quality and reliability. In the role of Process Engineer for BiMOS Backend, you will contribute to the advancement of our automated power module production. You'll have the opportunity to improve existing manufacturing processes and lead innovative development projects, with a particular focus on automated chip assembly and soldering. How you'll make an impact Improve the capability of chip attach processes through the application of statistical methods and design of experiments Analyse production data to enhance process performance, identify long-term trends, and support the prevention of potential failures Lead the optimization of automated production systems to improve manufacturing capacity, stability, and quality Support troubleshooting and root cause analysis activities to sustain and improve production throughput Contribute to new product development by shaping production processes and supporting the successful transition to volume manufacturing Your background A master's degree in industrial, mechanical, electrical, or chemical engineering, or a related field Several years of experience in an automated production environment Solid machine-vision and automated inspection skills, as well as experience in Pick and Place processes Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, a quality-focused mindset, and a proactive, hands-on approach Familiarity with DoE, data analysis, Six Sigma methodologies, and production statistics is a plus Proficiency in both German and English More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

These components are trusted across sectors such as power transmission and distribution, mobility, and renewable energy for their exceptional quality and reliability. In the role of Process Engineer for BiMOS Backend, you will contribute to the advancement of our automated power module production. You'll have the opportunity to improve existing manufacturing processes and lead innovative development projects, with a particular focus on automated chip assembly and soldering. How you'll make an impact Improve the capability of chip attach processes through the application of statistical methods and design of experiments Analyse production data to enhance process performance, identify long-term trends, and support the prevention of potential failures Lead the optimization of automated production systems to improve manufacturing capacity, stability, and quality Support troubleshooting and root cause analysis activities to sustain and improve production throughput Contribute to new product development by shaping production processes and supporting the successful transition to volume manufacturing Your background A master's degree in industrial, mechanical, electrical, or chemical engineering, or a related field Several years of experience in an automated production environment Solid machine-vision and automated inspection skills, as well as experience in Pick and Place processes Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, a quality-focused mindset, and a proactive, hands-on approach Familiarity with DoE, data analysis, Six Sigma methodologies, and production statistics is a plus Proficiency in both German and English More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

jobs.title: Photolithography Process Engineer 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity Join a high performing photolithography team where your expertise truly makes an impact. As a Senior Photolithography Engineer, you will be responsible for developing and optimizing photolithography processes used in semiconductor manufacturing. Your role will involve working with advanced lithography equipment, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and ensuring high-quality production standards. This is your opportunity to shape technical decisions, contribute to long term tool strategies, and drive meaningful improvements in stability, uptime, and process performance. Are you someone who takes ownership, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and enjoys making a real impact? Then apply today! How you'll make an impact Ensure processes meet the production program and yield goals and address any product yield and rework issues. Engage with equipment and material vendors to develop new solutions and improve existing processes, to ensure smooth functioning of the production line. Develop new techniques, modify existing designs, and coordinate process improvement projects. Analyze process data to identify trends, optimize performance, and troubleshoot issues (implement and regularly check SPC). Independent planning and Implementation of new machinery into the production line. Work closely with process integration, wet etch, diffusion, metals, dry etch, and implant teams to ensure seamless production. Supports some metrology tools i.e. to measure CD and Overlay. On-call duties on weekends and public holidays (as required from the production) with participation in the on-call meeting (before the on-call duty) agreed on his own responsibility with the other on-call service providers. Mansioni - Corso di laurea in un campo correlato (ad esempio, elettrico, meccanico, chimico, scienza dei materiali o fisica) con 5+ anni di esperienza nell'industria o master con 3+ anni di esperienza nell'industria o nel dottorato con esperienza nel settore - Ampia esperienza nelle operazioni di fotolitografia wafer, in particolare nel rivestimento e nell'esposizione in Steppers, in un ambiente di produzione di wafer (produzione di ondulazioni a testa di film, semiconduttore) - Familiarità con sistemi software di fabbrica di wafer automatizzati come SPC, MES e Experience con estrazione, manipolazione e analisi dei dati - Forte comprensione dell'ottica e della litografia di immersione - La competenza nella scienza dei dati e nella programmazione è preferita - Buone competenze linguistiche in inglese e tedesco - Capacità di lavorare in un ambiente pulito

descriptionByLocale.en:
## Descrizione - The opportunity Join a high performing photolithography team where your expertise truly makes an impact. - As a Senior Photolithography Engineer, you will be responsible for developing and optimizing photolithography processes used in semiconductor manufacturing. - Your role will involve working with advanced lithography equipment, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and ensuring high-quality production standards. - This is your opportunity to shape technical decisions, contribute to long term tool strategies, and drive meaningful improvements in stability, uptime, and process performance. - Are you someone who takes ownership, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and enjoys making a real impact? Then apply today! ## Mansioni - Bachelor's degree in a related field (e.g., Electrical, Mechanical, Chemical, Materials Science or Physics) with 5+ years of experience in industry or master's degree with 3+ years of experience in industry or Ph.D. with industry experience - Extensive experience in wafer photolithography operations especially in coating and exposure in Steppers, in a wafer manufacturing environment (thin-film-head, semiconductor wafer manufacturing) - Familiarity with automated wafer factory software systems like SPC, MES and Experience with data extraction, manipulation, and analysis - Strong understanding of optics and immersion lithography - Proficiency in data science and programming is preferred - Good English and German language skills - Ability to work in a cleanroom environment ##

• Cosa offriamo - Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

Dann bewerben Sie sich heute! Mansion - Bachelor-Abschluss in einem verwandten Bereich (z.B. Elektro, Mechanisch, Chemie, Materialwissenschaft oder Physik) mit 5+ Jahren Erfahrung in der Industrie oder Master-Abschluss mit 3+ Jahren Erfahrung in der Industrie oder Ph.D. mit Branchenerfahrung - Umfangreiche Erfahrung in der Wafer-Photolithographie, vor allem bei der Beschichtung und Belichtung in Steppers, in einer Wafer-Produktionsumgebung (Din-Film-Kopf, Halbleiterwafer-Herstellung) - Vertrautheit mit automatisierten Waferfabrik-Softwaresystemen wie SPC, MES und Experience mit Datenextraktion, Manipulation und Analyse - Starkes Verständnis von Optik und Immersionslithographie - Kenntnisse in der Datenwissenschaft und -programmierung werden bevorzugt - Gute Englisch- und Deutschkenntnisse - Fähigkeit, in einer Reinraumumgebung zu arbeiten Voraussetzungen - Mit Ausrüstungs- und Materialherstellern neue Lösungen zu entwickeln und bestehende Prozesse zu verbessern, um ein reibungsloses Funktionieren der Produktionslinie zu gewährleisten. - Entwicklung neuer Techniken, Änderung bestehender Designs und Koordinierung von Prozessverbesserungsprojekten. - Analysieren Sie Prozessdaten, um Trends zu identifizieren, die Leistung zu optimieren und Probleme zu beheben (implementieren und regelmäßig überprüfen SPC). - Unabhängige Planung und Implementierung neuer Maschinen in die Produktionslinie. - Arbeiten Sie eng mit Prozessintegration, Nassätzung, Diffusion, Metalle, Trockenätze und Implantat-Teams zusammen, um eine nahtlose Produktion zu gewährleisten. - Unterstützt einige Metrologie-Tools, um CD und Overlay zu messen. - An Wochenenden und Feiertagen (wie von der Produktion verlangt) mit Teilnahme an der On-Call-Sitzung (vor dem On-Call-Demand) vereinbarte die Eigenverantwortung der anderen On-Call-Dienstleister.

Alors appliquez aujourd'hui ! • Requisiti - S'engager avec les fournisseurs d'équipements et de matériaux pour développer de nouvelles solutions et améliorer les processus existants, pour assurer le bon fonctionnement de la chaîne de production. - Élaborer de nouvelles techniques, modifier les conceptions existantes et coordonner les projets d'amélioration des processus. - Analyser les données du processus pour identifier les tendances, optimiser les performances et résoudre les problèmes (mise en œuvre et vérification régulière du CPS). - Planification indépendante et mise en place de nouvelles machines dans la chaîne de production. - Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes d'intégration des procédés, d'éther humide, de diffusion, de métaux, d'éther sec et d'implants pour assurer une production transparente. - Supporte certains outils de métrologie, c'est-à-dire pour mesurer CD et Overlay. - Les services de garde les week-ends et jours fériés (selon les besoins de la production) avec participation à la réunion de garde (avant le service de garde) ont convenu de sa propre responsabilité avec les autres prestataires de services de garde.

jobs.title: Scientist - Reliability Engineering (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The Opportunity Empower the Future with Hitachi Energy! Join us as a Scientist in Reliability Engineering and become part of a passionate, dynamic, and innovative team driving the energy transition. We are seeking a skilled and motivated scientist to strengthen our research in the reliability of power grid components and systems. In this role, you will bridge theory and application—developing and validating cutting-edge methods and technologies that support a more sustainable energy future.   How you'll make an impact Drive innovation in reliability analysis, reliability improvement, and prognostics & health management for power grid components and systems Apply advanced techniques by combining reliability engineering, physics-of-failure insights, data analysis, mathematical modelling, and system tools to enhance the reliability of mission-critical equipment Collaborate globally with researchers and engineers across Hitachi Energy Research and business units to solve real-world challenges and identify opportunities for improvement Build strong networks within the company and with external partners, including universities, start-ups, and vendors Share your knowledge through scientific publications, patent applications, and technical reports   Your background PhD in Electrical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Physics, Data Science, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field Solid experience in one or more of the following areas is required: statistical and probabilistic modelling (e.g., Bayesian inference, Monte Carlo simulations), mathematical modelling and simulation (e.g., Markov chains, Poisson processes, Petri nets), data science and machine learning Familiarity with reliability engineering methods or condition health monitoring in domains such as mechanical or electronics is a strong plus Proven track record of scientific publications in top-tier journals and conferences Fluency in English, both written and spoken   More about us   At Hitachi Energy, we believe in the power of diversity and the potential of every individual. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. Join us in shaping a more sustainable and reliable energy future.

jobs.title: Internship in Variability Visualization Framework for Large-Scale Graphical Languages 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity The System and Automation team at the Swiss research center is looking for an intern student with expertise in data processing and visualization, software engineering, or software architecture to contribute to the development of a novel visual framework for variability management in large-scale graphical languages. The intern will interact with dynamic and multidisciplinary teams that will supervise and guide the project. If you have a strong technical background, motivation to develop innovative solutions, and you are goal-oriented, this is your opportunity to contribute to a stronger and more sustainable energy future. The duration of the internship is six months. How you'll make an impact Support the technology development and research activities in variability management for software systems Perform state-of-the-art and technology reviews: Benchmark the achieved results against state-of-the-art solutions for the given application Design, prototype, and\/or integrate tools that support the scalable analysis and management of software variability via intuitive visual interfaces Disseminate and report your results with the teams, write technical documentation, propose creative and efficient solutions towards industrial implementation    Your background The candidate should be enrolled in an MSc program in Computer Science, Data Science, Machine Learning, Control and Automation Engineering, or a related field The candidate should have a strong background in data engineering, software engineering, and\/or software architecture Experience in Python programming, UI\/UX and\/or simulation tools for power electronics (Simulink, PSCAD, PLECS) are strongly appreciated Excellent communication skills, team player attitude, initiative, and creativity Fluency in English, written and spoken More about us We are a technology-driven company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing. 
• We offer flexible working conditions, dedicated mentorship, and a supportive, inclusive environment where you can grow personally and professionally – empowering you to thrive while balancing life and work. We look forward to receiving your application, including a brief cover letter and a transcript of records, along with your CV. Non-EU\/EFTA citizens, please note that an official university certificate showing that an internship is a mandatory part of your studies is required.

jobs.title: Industrial Engineer for GIS Production 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity We are seeking a highly motivated Industrial Engineer with a focus on Automation and Robotics to optimize and improve the efficiency of our Gas Insulated Switchgear (GIS) production lines. This role involves applying industrial engineering principles as well as automation technologies and robotic solutions to enhance manufacturing processes, reduce waste, and improve productivity. Motivated graduates with a strong focus on automation and robotics are also encouraged to apply. How you'll make an impact Analyse current GIS production line layouts, workflows, and operational procedures to identify areas for improvement in efficiency, cost, and quality, with a focus on automation potential Design and implement optimized production processes, including new methodologies, automation concepts, robotic applications, equipment utilization, and material flow Conduct time and motion studies, process mapping, and value stream analysis to identify bottlenecks and eliminate non-value-added activities. Develop and implement standard operating procedures (SOPs) and work instructions for GIS assembly and testing, including automated and robot-assisted processes Collaborate with other industrial engineers, production managers, design engineers, quality and new product implementation team Lead and participate in continuous improvement initiatives, including Lean Manufacturing and Six Sigma projects, leveraging digitalization and automation technologies Evaluate, specify, and implement new technologies, including robotics (e.g., cobots), automated systems, and smart manufacturing solutions for the GIS production environment Your background Master's degree in Automation Engineering, Robotics, Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related field Initial professional experience in industrial engineering within a manufacturing environment is preferred Initial or proven experience with industrial automation and\/or robotics integration (e.g., robotic cells, cobots, automated material handling systems) Strong background in process optimization, lean manufacturing principles, and continuous improvement methodologies (e.g., Kaizen, Six Sigma) Proficiency in process analysis tools (e.g., value stream mapping, time studies, statistical process control) Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with diverse teams and manage multiple projects simultaneously Familiarity with GIS production processes or similar complex electrical equipment manufacturing is highly desirable Business fluent in English and German More about us   Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione La nostra azienda è alla ricerca di un ingegnere industriale motivato con un focus su Automazione e Robotica per ottimizzare e migliorare l'efficienza delle linee di produzione del nostro Switchgear Isolato a Gas (GIS). Questo ruolo prevede l'applicazione dei principi di ingegneria industriale, nonché delle tecnologie di automazione e delle soluzioni robotiche per migliorare i processi di produzione, ridurre i rifiuti e migliorare la produttività. Sono anche incoraggiati a candidarsi i laureati motivati ​​con un forte focus su automazione e robotica. Mansioni - Analizzare le attuali delle linee di produzione GIS, i flussi di lavoro e le procedure operative per identificare aree di miglioramento in termini di efficienza, costo e qualità, con un focus sul potenziale di automazione - Progettare e implementatori processi di produzione ottimizzati, comprese nuove metodologie, concetti di automazione, applicazioni robotiche, utilizzo di attrezzature e flusso di materiali - Condurre studi di tempo e moto, mappatura dei processi e analisi di flusso di valore per identificare i punti di bottiglia ed eliminare le attività non di valore - Sviluppatore e implementatori procedure operative standard (SOP) e istruzioni di lavoro per l'assemblaggio e il test del GIS, comprese le applicazioni automatizzate e robotizzate - Collaborare con altri ingegneri industriali, manager di produzione, ingegneri di progettazione, team di qualità e implementazione di nuovi prodotti - Guidare e partecipare a iniziative di miglioramento continuo, comprese progetti di Lean Manufacturing e Six Sigma, sfruttando le tecnologie di digitalizzazione e automazione - Valutare, specificare e implementare nuove tecnologie, comprese le robotiche (ad esempio, cobots), i sistemi automatizzati e le soluzioni di fabbricazione intelligente per l'ambiente di produzione GIS 
• Requisiti - Laurea magistrale in Ingegneria dell'Automazione, Robotica, Ingegneria Industriale, Ingegneria della Produzione o una disciplina correlata - Esperienza professionale iniziale nell'ingegneria industriale all'interno di un ambiente di produzione - Esperienza iniziale o dimostrata con l'integrazione di automazione industriale e/o robotica (ad esempio, celle robotiche, cobots, sistemi di manipolazione di materiali automatizzati) - Solida conoscenza dei principi di ottimizzazione dei processi, delle pratiche di Lean Manufacturing e delle metodologie di miglioramento continuo (ad esempio, Kaizen, Six Sigma) - Competenza in strumenti di analisi dei processi (ad esempio, mappatura dei flussi di valore, studi di tempo, controllo statistico dei processi) - Eccellenti abilità di comunicazione e interpersonali, con la capacità di lavorare efficacemente con team diversi e gestire progetti multipli contemporaneamente - Familiarità con i processi di produzione GIS o con la produzione di equipaggiamenti elettrici complessi cose simili - Pratiche di lavoro flessibili che aiutano a ottimizzare il rendimento personale e professionale, creando un ambiente in cui tutti gli impiegati possono Contatto sviluppare le loro competenze e crescere - (nessun contatto specifico)

Cet outil précède l'application des principes d'ingénierie industrielle, non seulement la technologie d'automatisation et les solutions robotiques pour améliorer les processus de production, améliorer les performances et améliorer la productivité. jobs.title: R&D Internship for Magnetics Design in Power Electronic Converter Systems 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity At Hitachi Energy Research, we closely collaborate with business areas to develop foundations for the next generation of Power Grids products. Located in the proximity of Zurich, the research center employs more than 60 scientists from all over the world with cross-disciplinary expertise. In the Systems Integration and Physics Team we address the challenges and opportunities in enhancing grid flexibility and facilitating renewable energy proliferation. A key focus of our work is multi-physics modeling for power electronic systems, which plays a critical role in fast-growing applications such as electric vehicle charging, energy storage and renewables like wind and solar. In this context, we offer an 6 months internship position which provides the opportunity of working on real-world projects in an international team of research scientists. How you'll make an impact Extension of a MATLAB-based tool for systematic and comprehensive design and optimization of magnetic components in power electronic converters Design and comparison of different winding types Design and comparison of different core materials Implementation and testing of models. Documentation of studies and results in technical reports Adaption of the code architecture as necessary to maintain clarity and facilitate easy maintenance Collaboration with an international research team and experts in power electronics    Your background Enrolled in a Master degree program in electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, computer sciences, or a similar discipline (completion of at least six semesters) Experience with MATLAB programming Familiar with magnetics in power electronic converters Enthusiastic, motivated and curious with good organizational skills and team spirit Highly conscientious professional with a strong sense of responsibility and excellent communication skills Fluency in English, written and spoken More about us We are a technology-driven company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing. 
• We offer flexible working conditions, dedicated mentorship, and a supportive, inclusive environment where you can grow personally and professionally – empowering you to thrive while balancing life and work. descriptionByLocale.fr:
The opportunity At Hitachi Energy Research, we closely collaborate with business areas to develop foundations for the next generation of Power Grids products. Located in the proximity of Zurich, the research center employs more than 60 scientists from all over the world with cross-disciplinary expertise. In the Systems Integration and Physics Team we address the challenges and opportunities in enhancing grid flexibility and facilitating renewable energy proliferation. A key focus of our work is multi-physics modeling for power electronic systems, which plays a critical role in fast-growing applications such as electric vehicle charging, energy storage and renewables like wind and solar. In this context, we offer an 6 months internship position which provides the opportunity of working on real-world projects in an international team of research scientists. descriptionByLocale.it: L'opportunità Hitachi Energy, High Voltage Products, è rinomata in tutto il mondo come specialista nella trasmissione e distribuzione di energia. La nostra unità Gas Insulated Switchgears (GIS), con sede a Zurigo-Oerlikon, è attiva nello sviluppo e nella produzione di sistemi di commutazione isolati in gas. Garantiamo l'elevata affidabilità dei nostri sistemi utilizzando strumenti e metodi di sviluppo all'avanguardia. Per la nostra business unit Prodotti ad alta tensione stiamo cercando un responsabile funzionale del team di standardizzazione in ingegneria secondaria. In questa posizione impegnativa assumerai la guida funzionale del team di standardizzazione per portare avanti la standardizzazione e i miglioramenti del prodotto. Lavorerai a stretto contatto con il team di ingegneria secondaria in Svizzera, Germania e India e svilupperai una tabella di marcia per la standardizzazione che guida lo sviluppo del nostro prodotto per il futuro. Comprovata esperienza nella gestione di progetti, certificazioni, ad es. poiché PMP è un vantaggio. Conoscenza della lingua inglese. descriptionByLocale.de:
Die Chance Hitachi Energy, High Voltage Products, ist weltweit als Spezialist für Stromübertragung und -verteilung bekannt. Unsere Einheit Gasisolierte Schaltanlagen (GIS) mit Sitz in Zürich-Oerlikon ist in der Entwicklung und Produktion von gasisolierten Schaltanlagen tätig. Die hohe Zuverlässigkeit unserer Systeme stellen wir durch den Einsatz modernster Entwicklungstools und -methoden sicher. Für unseren Geschäftsbereich Hochspannungsprodukte suchen wir einen funktionalen Leiter des Standardisierungsteams im Secondary Engineering. In dieser herausfordernden Position übernehmen Sie die funktionale Leitung des Standardisierungsteams, um die Produktstandardisierung und -verbesserungen voranzutreiben. Sie arbeiten eng mit dem Secondary Engineering-Team in der Schweiz, Deutschland und Indien zusammen und entwickeln eine Standardisierungs-Roadmap, die die Entwicklung unseres Produkts für die Zukunft leitet. Gemeinsam mit dem Standardisierungsteam sorgen Sie für die erfolgreiche Umsetzung von Verbesserungen, wie z. B. die Veröffentlichung neuer Vorlagen und Engineering-Richtlinien, die es dem Engineering ermöglichen, seine Projekte effektiv und in hoher Qualität abzuwickeln. Wie Sie etwas bewirken werden: Führen Sie das Secondary Engineering Standardisierungsteam funktional, einschließlich der täglichen Verwaltung von
• Aufgaben, Planung und Ausgleich der Teamarbeitsbelastung, stellen Sie Fortschritt, Transparenz und effektive Nutzung der Teamkapazität und Entwicklung der erforderlichen Kompetenzen sicher. Definieren Sie GIS Secondary Engineering Designstandards durch die Entwicklung von Vorlagen und Designrichtlinien mit Unterstützung des Standardisierungsteams und von Experten. Entwickeln, pflegen und aktualisieren Sie regelmäßig die Secondary Engineering Standardisierungs-Roadmap in Zusammenarbeit mit den Mitgliedern des Standardisierungsteams, den wichtigsten Interessenvertretern im Secondary Engineering und anderen Abteilungen. Beteiligen Sie sich den Qualitätsprozess und die kontinuierlichen Verbesserungszyklen der GIS-Organisation und arbeiten aktiv mit anderen Engineering-Teams und Stakeholdern zusammen, um Verbesserungen zu diskutieren, zu bewerten und auszurichten und sie für die Implementierung zu priorisieren. Führen Sie Verbesserungsaufgaben aus der Standardisierungs-Roadmap individuell aus und leiten Sie sie technisch. Treiben Sie die Standardisierung und Harmonisierung von E3-Vorlagen voran, um eine effiziente und qualitativ hochwertige Grundlage für projektspezifische Schaltpläne zu bieten. Ihr Hintergrund: Elektrotechnik-Hintergrund. Nachgewiesene Fähigkeit, erfolgreich zu leiten, entweder in Managementposition oder in anspruchsvollen und komplexen Projekten. Solide Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von Sekundärausrüstung (LCCs) als Secondary Engineering PM Erfahrung mit den entsprechenden Werkzeugen für Secondary Engineering Bereitschaft zur Übernahme einer funktionalen Führungsrolle innerhalb eines Teams. Nachgewiesene Erfahrung im Projektmanagement, Zertifizierung z.B. Da PMP ein Plus ist. Fließende Englischkenntnisse. Deutsch oder jede andere Sprache ist von Vorteil. Der Stelleninhaber lebt ein innovatives und leistungsorientiertes Denken sowie die Werte von Hitachi Energy und trägt persönlich zu einem guten Arbeitsklima bei. Mehr über uns. Unsere flexiblen Arbeitspraktiken helfen Ihnen, die persönliche und geschäftliche Leistung zu optimieren und gleichzeitig ein Umfeld zu schaffen, in dem alle Mitarbeiter ihre Fähigkeiten entwickeln und wachsen können.
descriptionByLocale.fr: L'opportunité Hitachi Energy, High Voltage Products, est reconnu dans le monde entier comme un spécialiste du transport et de la distribution d'énergie. Notre unité Gas Insulated Switchgears (GIS), basée à Zürich-Oerlikon, est active dans le développement et la production de systèmes de commutation à isolation gazeuse. Nous garantissons la haute fiabilité de nos systèmes en utilisant des outils et des méthodes de développement de pointe. Pour notre unité commerciale Produits Haute Tension, nous recherchons un responsable fonctionnel de l'équipe de normalisation en ingénierie secondaire. Dans ce poste stimulant, vous assumerez la direction fonctionnelle de l'équipe de normalisation afin de faire progresser la normalisation et les améliorations des produits. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec l'équipe d'ingénierie secondaire en Suisse, en Allemagne et en Inde et développerez une feuille de route de normalisation qui guide le développement de notre produit pour l'avenir. En collaboration avec l'équipe de normalisation, vous assurerez la mise en œuvre réussie des améliorations, telles que la publication de nouveaux modèles et de directives d'ingénierie qui permettent à l'ingénierie de réaliser ses projets de manière efficace et de haute qualité. Comment vous aurez un impact Diriger fonctionnellement l'équipe de normalisation de l'ingénierie secondaire, y compris la gestion quotidienne des tâches, la planification et l'équilibrage de la charge de travail de l'équipe, en garantissant les progrès, la transparence et l'utilisation efficace de la capacité de l'équipe et le développement des compétences requises. Définir les normes de conception de l'ingénierie secondaire SIG à travers le développement de modèles et de lignes directrices de conception avec le soutien de l'équipe de normalisation et des experts. Cycles d'amélioration continue de l'organisation SIG et collaborer activement avec d'autres équipes d'ingénierie et parties prenantes pour discuter, évaluer et aligner les améliorations, et les hiérarchiser pour la mise en œuvre. Exécuter et diriger techniquement les tâches d'amélioration de la feuille de route de normalisation individuellement. Piloter la normalisation et l'harmonisation des modèles E3 pour fournir une base efficace et de haute qualité pour les schémas spécifiques au projet. Votre expérience Formation en génie électrique Capacité démontrée à diriger avec succès, soit dans un poste de direction, soit dans des projets difficiles et complexes. Solide expérience en ingénierie des équipements secondaires (LCC) en tant que PM en ingénierie secondaire. les outils correspondants utilisés pour la préparation à l'ingénierie secondaire pour assumer le rôle de leadership fonctionnel au sein d'une équipe. Expérience avérée en gestion de projet, certification, par ex. car PMP est un plus. Maîtrise de l'anglais. L'allemand ou toute autre langue est un plus. Le propriétaire du poste vit une pensée innovante et axée sur la performance, suit les valeurs d'Hitachi Energy et apporte une contribution personnelle à une bonne atmosphère de travail. En savoir plus sur nous Nos pratiques de travail flexibles vous aident à optimiser les performances personnelles et professionnelles tout en créant un environnement où tous les employés peuvent développer leurs compétences et grandir.

jobs.title: Teamleiter Instandhaltung 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: Über die Position In unserem Profit Center in Wettingen produzieren und offerieren wir innovative, zuverlässige und sichere Überspannungsschutzlösungen für die Segmente Stromerzeugung\/-verteilung sowie Railway und Industrie. Unser Anspruch ist es, unsere Kundinnen und Kunden weltweit mit hochwertigen Technologien zu unterstützen und nachhaltige Mehrwerte zu schaffen. Dies gelingt durch die kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung unserer Kerntechnologien sowie durch die stetige Verbesserung unserer Prozesse – getragen von offener Zusammenarbeit und einem starken Teamgeist. Als Teamleiter Instandhaltung übernimmst du eine verantwortungsvolle Rolle und führst ein engagiertes Team von sechs Mitarbeitenden. descriptionByLocale.it: Informazioni sulla posizione Nel nostro centro di profitto a Wettingen produciamo e offriamo soluzioni di protezione contro le sovratensioni innovative, affidabili e sicure per la produzione/distribuzione di energia, nonché per i segmenti ferroviario e industriale. descriptionByLocale.fr: À propos du poste Dans notre centre de profit de Wettingen, nous produisons et proposons des solutions de protection contre les surtensions innovantes, fiables et sûres pour les secteurs de la production/distribution d'électricité ainsi que des secteurs ferroviaire et industriel. Notre objectif est de soutenir nos clients dans le monde entier avec des technologies de haute qualité et de créer une valeur ajoutée durable. Ceci est réalisé grâce au développement continu de nos technologies de base et à l’amélioration constante de nos processus – soutenus par une collaboration ouverte et un fort esprit d’équipe. En tant que chef d'équipe de maintenance, vous assumez un rôle responsable et dirigez une équipe engagée de six employés. Ensemble, vous veillez à ce que toutes les installations de production et tous les systèmes techniques fonctionnent de manière fiable dans le cadre d'une production hautement automatisée. Vous façonnez activement le développement futur de la maintenance - tant sur le plan stratégique qu'opérationnel - et travaillez en étroite collaboration et en partenariat avec la direction et d'autres domaines. L’objectif est de garantir une disponibilité élevée du système, la sécurité et une organisation efficace et durable. C'est ce que vous pouvez réaliser En collaboration avec votre équipe, l'organisation de maintenance est développée et renforcée. La planification, la coordination et la mise en œuvre des mesures de maintenance et de réparation (préventives, correctives et holistiques) relèvent de votre responsabilité. Des stratégies durables visant à améliorer la disponibilité, la productivité et la durée de vie des systèmes sont initiées et pilotées par vous. Le développement professionnel et personnel de votre équipe est activement soutenu et encouragé. La responsabilité de la planification budgétaire ainsi que d'une utilisation consciente et durable des ressources (y compris les pièces de rechange et la stratégie de stockage) font partie de votre rôle. Lors de la conversion, vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec divers départements sur les nouveaux projets de construction et d'investissement. Vous veillerez au respect des normes de sécurité, environnementales et de qualité. Les processus seront continuellement améliorés et complétés par des solutions numériques modernes et des systèmes d'indicateurs de performance clés. Ce que vous apportez avec vous Un diplôme technique complété (par ex. Ingénierie, mécatronique, électrotechnique, technologie d'automatisation) ou une qualification comparable constitue votre base. Vous possédez plusieurs années d'expérience en maintenance et idéalement dans un rôle managérial au sein d'une production automatisée. Vous avez des connaissances en automatisation, robots et systèmes de contrôle. Une expérience des approches de maintenance structurées et d’amélioration continue complète votre profil. Vous aimez travailler avec différents domaines spécialisés. Une façon de travailler structurée et orientée vers les solutions combinée à une capacité d'accompagnement et de développement des personnes est ce qui vous différencie. Une très bonne connaissance de l'allemand et de l'anglais est requise. En savoir plus sur nous Nos modèles de travail flexibles vous aident à bien combiner travail et vie privée. Un environnement valorisant est important pour nous afin que vous puissiez vous impliquer, vous développer davantage et libérer votre potentiel. --- Traduction en anglais ci-dessous --- Chef d'équipe Maintenance 80–100 % (f\/m\/d) L'opportunité Dans notre centre de profit de parasurtenseurs à Wettingen, vous travaillerez avec nous pour développer, fabriquer et fournir des solutions de protection contre les surtensions innovantes, fiables et sûres pour les secteurs de la production et de la distribution d'électricité, des chemins de fer et de l'industrie. jobs.description: The opportunity  Join our innovative team as a Shift Maintenance Engineer and play a critical role in the heart of semiconductor production! With a strong focus on etching processes, you'll work with cutting-edge technology to optimize system performance and ensure seamless operations. This is your opportunity to collaborate with experts, contribute to groundbreaking projects, and grow in a dynamic, high-tech environment. If you're passionate about precision and innovation, we want to hear from you!   How you'll make an impact  Maintain and optimize wet chemical and plasma etch equipment to ensure high availability  Troubleshoot and repair complex systems in collaboration with OEM partners  Plan and support preventive maintenance activities to improve tool performance  Manage spare parts and contribute to equipment upgrades and process improvements  Collaborate with engineering, R&D, and operations teams to support production goals  Create and maintain technical documentation and support data tracking in MES systems  Identify and implement improvements in tools, processes, and operational efficiency  Ensure compliance with HSE standards and promote a safe working environment  Your background  Technical vocational training in automation, electronics, or a related field (EFZ or equivalent)  2+ years of experience in equipment maintenance in semiconductor or similar industries  Strong technical knowledge in plasma tools (e.g. AMAT, LAM systems)  Solid understanding of electronics, mechanics, pneumatics, and vacuum systems  Ability to work in a team-oriented environment and within shift operations  Good communication skills in English (German is a plus)  More about us   You will join a dynamic and fast-paced production environment where teamwork, reliability, and technical excellence are key.  Working in a shift-based setup, you will be part of a highly skilled maintenance team supporting critical operations and advanced manufacturing processes.  This role offers hands-on experience with complex technologies and the opportunity to develop your technical skills while contributing directly to production stability and performance.

descriptionByLocale.de: Die Gelegenheit: Hitachi Energy sucht einen erfahrenen und motivierten F&E-Teammanager zur Leitung unseres Next Generation Grids Transformers-Teams in Genf, Schweiz. En savoir plus sur nous Vous rejoindrez un environnement de R&D collaboratif et international à la pointe des technologies de réseau de nouvelle génération. En travaillant à Genève, vous contribuerez à des solutions de transformateurs innovantes qui soutiennent la transition énergétique et le développement de systèmes électriques plus flexibles et durables. descriptionByLocale.de: Die Gelegenheit: Werden Sie Teil eines dynamischen Teams an der Spitze der Hochspannungstechnologie, in dem Ihre Kreativität und Präzision die Zukunft kundenspezifischer Durchführungen gestalten werden. Als Designer übernehmen Sie die Verantwortung für innovative mechanische Lösungen, optimieren Designs hinsichtlich Leistung und Herstellbarkeit und tragen direkt zu hochmodernen Entwicklungsprojekten bei. Dies ist Ihre Chance, praxisnah mit fortschrittlichen Tools wie Creo und SAP zu arbeiten und gleichzeitig in einer kollaborativen, zukunftsorientierten Umgebung kontinuierliche Verbesserungen voranzutreiben. Wenn Sie eine Leidenschaft für technische Exzellenz haben und bereit sind, spürbare Veränderungen zu bewirken, ist diese Stelle genau das Richtige für Sie. Wie Sie etwas bewegen können Entwicklung und Konstruktion von kundenspezifischen Hochspannungsdurchführungen Pflege und Erstellung von technischen Dokumentationen, Stücklisten und Stammdaten im SAP-System Umsetzung technischer Spezifikationen und Anwendung von Maß-, Form- und Lagetoleranzen Optimierung bestehender Konstruktionen hinsichtlich Effizienz, Herstellbarkeit und Qualität Selbstständige Durchführung kleinerer Entwicklungsprojekte oder Werkzeugverbesserungen Unterstützung bei der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung unserer Prozesse und Produkte Ihr Hintergrund Abgeschlossene Ausbildung zum Konstrukteur (EFZ) oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation 3 bis 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der mechanischen Konstruktion oder im Produktdesign. Fundierte Kenntnisse im 3D-Design, idealerweise mit Creo (PTC). Selbständiger, zuverlässiger und lösungsorientierter Arbeitsstil. Hohes Maß an Eigeninitiative und Verantwortungsbewusstsein. Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift; Englischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil. Mehr über uns. Unsere flexiblen Arbeitspraktiken helfen Ihnen, Ihre persönliche und geschäftliche Leistung zu optimieren und gleichzeitig ein Umfeld zu schaffen, in dem alle Mitarbeiter ihre Fähigkeiten entwickeln und wachsen können.

jobs.title: Umweltspezialist 80 - 100% (w/m/d)
jobs.description: Über die Position Gestalte aktiv die Zukunft mit – dort, wo Sicherheit und Innovation aufeinandertreffen. Wir suchen eine engagierte und fachkompetente Umweltspezialistin bzw. einen engagierten und fachkompetenten Umweltspezialisten, die\/der unser Bestreben nach einem sicheren, gesunden und nachhaltigen Arbeitsumfeld weiter stärkt. In dieser zentralen Funktion verantwortest du Initiativen zum Schutz unserer Mitarbeitenden, stellst die Einhaltung relevanter Vorschriften sicher und förderst eine proaktive Sicherheits- und Umweltkultur im gesamten Unternehmen. Das kannst du bewirken Sicherstellen der Einhaltung von Umwelt‑ und Sicherheitsvorschriften sowie interner Richtlinien Durchführen von Risiko‑, Gefahren‑ und Umweltanalysen inklusive Ableitung von Massnahmen Planen und Durchführen von internen Audits, Begehungen und Umweltkontrollen Untersuchen von Unfällen und Ereignissen sowie Erarbeitung von Präventionsmassnahmen Mitarbeit an Nachhaltigkeit‑ und Umweltprojekten sowie Förderung der Umweltkultur Erstellen und Durchführen von Schulungen zu Umwelt‑ und Sicherheitsrelevanten Themen Beratung und Unterstützung von Führungskräften und Projektteams bei HSE‑Fragestellungen Zusammenarbeit mit Behörden, Auditoren und externen Partnern Das bringst du mit Abschluss in Umweltwissenschaften, Umwelttechnik, Arbeitssicherheit oder einem vergleichbaren technischen\/naturwissenschaftlichen Bereich (FH\/Universität) Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im HSE oder Umweltbereich, idealerweise in Industrie, Produktion oder technischen Organisationen Fundierte Kenntnisse der Schweizer Arbeitssicherheits- und Umweltgesetzgebung, inklusive relevanter Verordnungen (z. B. Störfallverordnung, Chemikalienrecht, Umweltschutzrecht) Erfahrung in der Durchführung von Risikoanalysen, Gefahrenermittlungen sowie Unfall und Ereignisabklärungen, inklusive Ableitung von Massnahmen Praxis in der Planung, Durchführung und Nachbereitung von Audits, Inspektionen und internen Begehungen, idealerweise gemäss ISO 14001 \/ ISO 45001 Starke Kommunikations- und Beratungskompetenzen für die Unterstützung von Führungskräften, Projektleitenden und Mitarbeitenden in HSE-Belangen Fähigkeit zur Erstellung und Durchführung von Schulungen zu Arbeitssicherheit, Umwelt und Nachhaltigkeit, sowie Analytische Fähigkeiten und Erfahrung im Umgang mit HSE-Kennzahlen, Reporting und kontinuierlicher Verbesserung Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sowie gute Englischkenntnisse, weitere Landessprachen von Vorteil Mehr über uns Unsere flexiblen Arbeitsmodelle helfen Ihnen, persönliche und berufliche Leistung zu optimieren und schaffen ein Umfeld, in dem alle Mitarbeitenden ihre Fähigkeiten weiterentwickeln und wachsen können.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Informazioni sulla posizione Plasma attivamente il futuro: dove sicurezza e innovazione si incontrano.
• Cerchiamo uno specialista ambientale impegnato e competente che rafforzerà ulteriormente il nostro impegno per un ambiente di lavoro sicuro, sano e sostenibile. In questo ruolo centrale, sarai responsabile di iniziative volte a proteggere i nostri dipendenti, garantire il rispetto delle normative pertinenti e promuovere una cultura proattiva della sicurezza e dell'ambiente in tutta l'azienda. Questo è quello che puoi fare: Garantire il rispetto delle normative ambientali e di sicurezza e delle linee guida interne Effettuare analisi di rischi, pericoli e ambientali, compresa la derivazione di misure Pianificare ed eseguire audit interni, ispezioni e controlli ambientali Indagare su incidenti ed eventi e sviluppare misure preventive Lavorare su progetti ambientali e di sostenibilità, nonché promuovere la cultura ambientale Creare e svolgere formazione su temi legati all'ambiente e alla sicurezza Consigliare e supportare manager e... Team di progetto su questioni HSE Collaborazione con autorità, revisori e partner esterni Questo è ciò che puoi fare con una laurea in scienze ambientali, tecnologie ambientali, sicurezza sul lavoro o un settore tecnico-scientifico comparabile (Scienze professionali/Università) Esperienza professionale pluriennale nel settore HSE o ambientale, preferibilmente in organizzazioni industriali, produttive o tecniche Conoscenza approfondita della legislazione svizzera in materia di sicurezza sul lavoro e ambientale, comprese le norme pertinenti (ad es. norme sugli incidenti rilevanti, legge sui prodotti chimici, legge sulla protezione dell'ambiente) Esperienza nell'esecuzione di analisi dei rischi, indagini sui pericoli e chiarimenti su incidenti ed eventi, inclusa la derivazione di misure Pratica nella pianificazione, attuazione e follow-up di audit, ispezioni e ispezioni interne, preferibilmente in conformità con ISO 14001 / ISO 45001 Forti capacità di comunicazione e consulenza per supportare manager, project manager e dipendenti in questioni HSE Capacità di creare e realizzare corsi di formazione su sicurezza sul lavoro, ambiente e sostenibilità, nonché capacità analitiche ed esperienza nel trattare con figure chiave HSE, reporting e miglioramento continuo Ottima conoscenza del tedesco e buona conoscenza dell'inglese, altre lingue nazionali sono un vantaggio Maggiori informazioni su di noi I nostri modelli di lavoro flessibili vi aiutano a ottimizzare il personale e prestazioni professionali e creare un ambiente in cui tutti i dipendenti possano sviluppare ulteriormente le proprie competenze e crescere.
descriptionByLocale.en: About the position Actively shape the future – where security and innovation meet. We are looking for a committed and competent environmental specialist who will further strengthen our commitment to a safe, healthy and sustainable working environment. In this central role, you will be responsible for initiatives to protect our employees, ensure compliance with relevant regulations and promote a proactive safety and environmental culture across the company. This is what you can do: Ensuring compliance with environmental and safety regulations and internal guidelines Carrying out risk, hazard and environmental analyzes including the derivation of measures Planning and carrying out internal audits, inspections and environmental controls Investigating accidents and events and developing preventive measures Working on sustainability and environmental projects as well as promoting environmental culture Creating and carrying out training on environmental and safety-related topics Advising and supporting managers and... Project teams on HSE issues Collaboration with authorities, auditors and external partners This is what you bring with a degree in environmental sciences, environmental technology, occupational safety or a comparable technical/scientific field (university of applied sciences/university) Several years of professional experience in the HSE or environmental sector, ideally in industry, production or technical organizations Sound knowledge of Swiss occupational safety and environmental legislation, including relevant regulations (e.g. major accident regulations, chemicals law, environmental protection law) Experience in carrying out risk analyses, Hazard investigations as well as accident and event clarifications, including the derivation of measures Practice in the planning, implementation and follow-up of audits, inspections and internal inspections, ideally in accordance with ISO 14001 / ISO 45001 Strong communication and consulting skills for supporting managers, project managers and employees in HSE matters Ability to create and carry out training courses on occupational safety, environment and sustainability, as well as analytical skills and experience in dealing with HSE key figures, reporting and continuous improvement Very good knowledge of German and good knowledge of English, other national languages are an advantage More about us Our flexible working models help you to optimize personal and professional performance and create an environment in which all employees can further develop their skills and grow.

descriptionByLocale.fr: À propos du poste Façonner activement l’avenir – là où la sécurité et l’innovation se rencontrent. Nous recherchons un spécialiste de l'environnement engagé et compétent qui renforcera encore notre engagement en faveur d'un environnement de travail sûr, sain et durable. Dans ce rôle central, vous serez responsable des initiatives visant à protéger nos employés, à garantir le respect des réglementations en vigueur et à promouvoir une culture proactive de sécurité et d'environnement dans l'ensemble de l'entreprise. Voici ce que vous pouvez faire : Assurer le respect des réglementations environnementales et de sécurité et des directives internes Effectuer des analyses de risques, de dangers et environnementales, y compris l'élaboration de mesures Planifier et réaliser des audits internes, des inspections et des contrôles environnementaux Enquêter sur les accidents et les événements et élaborer des mesures préventives Travailler sur des projets de développement durable et environnementaux ainsi que promouvoir la culture environnementale Créer et réaliser des formations sur des sujets liés à l'environnement et à la sécurité Conseiller et soutenir les gestionnaires et... Les équipes de projet sur les questions HSE Collaboration avec les autorités, les auditeurs et les partenaires externes C'est ce que vous apportez un diplôme en environnement sciences, technologies de l'environnement, sécurité au travail ou domaine technique/scientifique comparable (haute école spécialisée/université) Plusieurs années d'expérience professionnelle dans le secteur HSE ou environnement, idéalement dans l'industrie, la production ou des organisations techniques. Bonne connaissance de la législation suisse en matière de sécurité au travail et d'environnement, y compris les réglementations pertinentes (par exemple, réglementation sur les accidents majeurs, loi sur les produits chimiques, loi sur la protection de l'environnement). inspections et inspections internes, idéalement conformes à la norme ISO 14001 / ISO 45001. Solides compétences en communication et en conseil pour accompagner les managers, chefs de projet et employés en matière HSE. Capacité à créer et animer des formations sur la sécurité au travail, l'environnement et la durabilité, ainsi que compétences analytiques et expérience dans le traitement des chiffres clés HSE, reporting et amélioration continue. Très bonne connaissance de l'allemand et bonne connaissance de l'anglais, d'autres langues nationales sont un avantage. En savoir plus sur nous. jobs.title: Cluster Security Manager 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity In this role, you will serve as a recognized subject matter expert in security, providing competent functional support across a country or cluster of countries. You will be responsible for researching, analysing, and interpreting emerging security threats that could impact employees, assets, or operations. You will play a key role in organizational resilience, crisis management, and the implementation of Hitachi Energy's global and regional security strategies. Reporting to the Head of Regional Security, you will manage complex projects with limited supervision, coach lower-level professionals, and contribute to critical business decisions through expert security insights. How you'll make an impact Analyze emerging domestic and international security threats and provide timely assessments and advisories. Deliver competent security support across the country\/cluster, ensuring alignment with regional security standards and KPIs. Ensure compliance through audits, inspections, and monitoring of evolving security legislation. Provide expert security risk management advice to support key business decisions. Drive continuous improvement and behavioural change through global and regional security initiatives. Engage internal and external stakeholders to strengthen security awareness and performance. Lead or support security-related projects, managing objectives, resources, and reporting. Coordinate organizational resilience, emergency response, and country-level crisis management. Your background Min. 5 years Advanced education and significant experience as a security specialist. Proven expertise in threat intelligence, risk analysis, and crisis management. Strong understanding of security standards, legislation, compliance requirements, and audit processes. Experience coaching and advising leaders on security matters within a complex organization. Business fluent in German and English. Demonstrated ability to manage security programs, projects, and budgets effectively. Skilled in stakeholder engagement, communication, and cross-functional collaboration. Experience in organizational resilience, emergency response, and business continuity coordination. Ability to operate in a global matrix environment and manage responsibilities across multiple countries. Approx. 30% Travel required More about us   Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptionByLocale.it: L'opportunità In questo ruolo, ricoprirai il ruolo di esperto riconosciuto in materia di sicurezza, fornendo supporto funzionale competente in un paese o un gruppo di paesi. Sarai responsabile della ricerca, dell'analisi e dell'interpretazione delle minacce alla sicurezza emergenti che potrebbero avere un impatto su dipendenti, risorse o operazioni. Avrai un ruolo chiave nella resilienza organizzativa, nella gestione delle crisi e nell'implementazione delle strategie di sicurezza globali e regionali di Hitachi Energy. Riportando al responsabile della sicurezza regionale, gestirai progetti complessi con supervisione limitata, istruirai professionisti di livello inferiore e contribuirai a decisioni aziendali critiche attraverso approfondimenti di esperti sulla sicurezza. Come avrai un impatto Analizza le minacce emergenti alla sicurezza nazionale e internazionale e fornisci valutazioni e consulenze tempestive. Fornire supporto di sicurezza competente in tutto il paese/cluster, garantendo l'allineamento con gli standard di sicurezza e i KPI regionali. Garantisci la conformità attraverso audit, ispezioni e monitoraggio dell'evoluzione della legislazione sulla sicurezza. Fornire consulenza esperta sulla gestione dei rischi per la sicurezza per supportare le decisioni aziendali chiave. Promuovere il miglioramento continuo e il cambiamento comportamentale attraverso iniziative di sicurezza globali e regionali. Coinvolgere le parti interessate interne ed esterne per rafforzare la consapevolezza e le prestazioni in materia di sicurezza. Guidare o supportare progetti relativi alla sicurezza, gestendo obiettivi, risorse e reporting. Coordinare la resilienza organizzativa, la risposta alle emergenze e la gestione delle crisi a livello nazionale. Il tuo backgroundMin. 5 anni di formazione avanzata e significativa esperienza come specialista della sicurezza. Comprovata esperienza nell'intelligence sulle minacce, nell'analisi dei rischi e nella gestione delle crisi. Ottima conoscenza degli standard di sicurezza, della legislazione, dei requisiti di conformità e dei processi di audit. Esperienza di coaching e consulenza ai leader su questioni di sicurezza all'interno di un'organizzazione complessa. Affari fluente in tedesco e inglese. Capacità dimostrata di gestire programmi, progetti e budget di sicurezza in modo efficace. Abile nel coinvolgimento degli stakeholder, nella comunicazione e nella collaborazione interfunzionale. descriptionByLocale.en: The opportunity In this role, you will serve as a recognized subject matter expert in security, providing competent functional support across a country or cluster of countries. You will be responsible for researching, analysing, and interpreting emerging security threats that could impact employees, assets, or operations. You will play a key role in organizational resilience, crisis management, and the implementation of Hitachi Energy's global and regional security strategies. Reporting to the Head of Regional Security, you will manage complex projects with limited supervision, coach lower-level professionals, and contribute to critical business decisions through expert security insights. How you'll make an impact Analyze emerging domestic and international security threats and provide timely assessments and advisories. Deliver competent security support across the country\/cluster, ensuring alignment with regional security standards and KPIs. Ensure compliance through audits, inspections, and monitoring of evolving security legislation. Provide expert security risk management advice to support key business decisions. Drive continuous improvement and behavioural change through global and regional security initiatives. Engage internal and external stakeholders to strengthen security awareness and performance. Lead or support security-related projects, managing objectives, resources, and reporting. Coordinate organizational resilience, emergency response, and country-level crisis management. Your background Min. 5 years Advanced education and significant experience as a security specialist. Proven expertise in threat intelligence, risk analysis, and crisis management. Strong understanding of security standards, legislation, compliance requirements, and audit processes. Experience coaching and advising leaders on security matters within a complex organization. Business fluent in German and English. Demonstrated ability to manage security programs, projects, and budgets effectively. Skilled in stakeholder engagement, communication, and cross-functional collaboration. Experience in organizational resilience, emergency response, and business continuity coordination. Ability to operate in a global matrix environment and manage responsibilities across multiple countries. Approx. 30% Travel required More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Die Chance: In dieser Rolle fungieren Sie als anerkannter Fachexperte für Sicherheit und bieten kompetente funktionale Unterstützung in einem Land oder einer Ländergruppe. Sie sind für die Erforschung, Analyse und Interpretation neu auftretender Sicherheitsbedrohungen verantwortlich, die sich auf Mitarbeiter, Vermögenswerte oder Abläufe auswirken könnten. Sie spielen eine Schlüsselrolle bei der organisatorischen Widerstandsfähigkeit, dem Krisenmanagement und der Umsetzung der globalen und regionalen Sicherheitsstrategien von Hitachi Energy. Als Berichterstatter an den Leiter der regionalen Sicherheit leiten Sie komplexe Projekte mit begrenzter Aufsicht, coachen untergeordnete Fachkräfte und tragen durch fachkundige Sicherheitskenntnisse zu wichtigen Geschäftsentscheidungen bei. Bieten Sie kompetente Sicherheitsunterstützung im ganzen Land/Cluster und stellen Sie die Übereinstimmung mit regionalen Sicherheitsstandards und KPIs sicher. Stellen Sie die Einhaltung durch Audits, Inspektionen und Überwachung der sich entwickelnden Sicherheitsgesetze sicher. Bieten Sie fachkundige Beratung zum Sicherheitsrisikomanagement, um wichtige Geschäftsentscheidungen zu unterstützen. Fördern Sie kontinuierliche Verbesserungen und Verhaltensänderungen durch globale und regionale Sicherheitsinitiativen. Binden Sie interne und externe Stakeholder ein, um das Sicherheitsbewusstsein und die Leistung zu stärken. Leiten oder unterstützen Sie sicherheitsrelevante Projekte und verwalten Sie Ziele, Ressourcen und Berichte. Koordinieren Sie die Widerstandsfähigkeit der Organisation, die Notfallreaktion und das Krisenmanagement auf Landesebene. Ihr Hintergrund: Min. 5 Jahre Fortgeschrittene Ausbildung und umfangreiche Erfahrung als Sicherheitsspezialist. Nachgewiesene Expertise in Bedrohungsanalyse, Risikoanalyse und Krisenmanagement. Ausgeprägtes Verständnis von Sicherheitsstandards, Gesetzen, Compliance-
• Anforderungen und Audit-Prozessen. Erleben Sie Coaching und Beratung von Führungskräften in Sicherheitsfragen innerhalb einer komplexen Organisation. Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse. Nachgewiesene Fähigkeit, Sicherheitsprogramme, Projekte und Budgets effektiv zu verwalten. Versiert in Stakeholder-Engagement, Kommunikation und funktionsübergreifender Zusammenarbeit. Erfahrung in organisatorischer Belastbarkeit, Notfallreaktion und Geschäftskontinuitätskoordination. Fähigkeit, in einer globalen Matrixumgebung zu agieren und Verantwortlichkeiten über mehrere Länder hinweg zu verwalten.
